description:
You will learn how to make many types of homemade pasta in a real laboratory of pasta, reviewed among the "best 10 pastificio in Rome" . We will start with handmade pasta, made with different kind of flours: like ancient grain Triticum Monococcum, Grano Saraceno (buckwheat) and wholemeal flour. We will do thin sheets dough, explanation of safe food cutting procedures, realization of three types of ravioli, tortellini, fettuccine with two tipical italian sauces. The experience includes a delicious tasting of local cheese.
We can also accomodate GLUTEN allergy guests for a very tasty fresh pasta and VEGAN guests for pasta without eggs.
We will cook all pasta and the sauces made during the class, eating our differents kind of pasta done, sipping good italian wine. An express tiramisu preparation will follow as a dessert. Moreover, to all the participants will be offered complimentary, the exclusive Professional Chef Hat with logo of "Pastificio Faini". In additional to the regular program, everyday of the week a different version will be presented: Monday and Saturday Carbonara sauce; Tuesday-Friday CacioPepe sauce; Wednesday amatriciana, Thursday gnocchi!
A membership registration is requested to make the class. (no extra cost is due).
Same program available also in our second experience "Five Shapes of pasta in Antica Osteria"
locationDescription: Pastificio Faini is shop where we make and prepare pasta. Is located in the historic district of San Lorenzo in Rome, just 10 minutes walk from the metro station Vittorio Emanuele and liked by many bus like number 71 that run in the center. I will wait you in my laboratory.

reviews.text: What an amazing experience Emanuel and his business partner were so much fun. We learned how to make pasta it was so good!! It was exceptional !!

Exceptional pasta learning and tasting experience! Just book and thank Emanuele later ;) Perfect location, equipment and the best teachers to learn everything about Pasta and Gnocchi. Thanks a lot. Keep up the spirit.

What a nice experience! My sister and I loved the workshop. You learn in a very entertaining way how to prepare pasta yourself. We particularly liked that you can easily try out the recipes again at home. In addition, the atmosphere was very relaxed, friendly and just fun. We would 100% recommend this workshop.

Emanuele and team were personable, fun and above all, great teachers. Everything was coordinated like clockwork and they managed to easily get 12 students of varying degrees of skill to prepare a delicious pasta lunch. The setting was lovely and perfectly sized and organized for the group. Everything from the flowers and candles on the table to the final bite of hand made pasta was perfection.

This was a truly amazing experience that I would recommend to anyone visiting or living in Rome. It is a perfect date, but could also be done alone, with friends, or family. I was pregnant and they were so accommodating by ensuring I knew what was cooked and what I could eat safely. Additionally, the owner was so genuine and caring and passionate. The entire staff was welcoming and friendly. I can’t say it enough, you MUST do this if you’re in town !

Fantastic experience! You will learn to make pasta from true professionals. Everything is set up for you and organized with perfection. Still, they keep it simple so everyone can lean the basics. Even experienced pasta makers will learn a few tips and tricks to make their pasta even better!

If you are thinking about booking and they have space available when you want to go, BOOK IT NOW! The class will fill up as you get close to the date and you will miss out on a great experience.

Pasta making with Emanuele and his team was some of the most fun we had on our Italy vacation. We were looking forward to taking a cooking class in Rome and this experience did not disappoint. We learned so much and to be hands on with the entire process was great. The food was awesome and the ambiance was lively. I look forward to making pasta on my own back home.
So much fun, and a great way to get a hands on experience that felt truly authentic! The teachers are jovial and knowledgeable.

This is was a very fun experience. The walk to the location was a bit sketchy if you take the route via the side of Roma Termini. However, once you arrive you’ll be greeted warmly and pleased to discover a well equipped and comfortable space. The class size was not too big and the chefs are accessible and eager to encourage and instruct you. Also, you should know, this whole class is by hand. Meaning, there’s no pasta cranking here. It’s the real deal. Book this class and enjoy withy our partner and family.

If you want to have a great time while making pasta and then enjoying them, I highly recommend Emanuele's activity.
Educational, kind and caring, Emmanuel and his colleague were able to guide us, advise us, and share their knowledge of pasta creation.

🍝 A great time to chat and share 🙏🏻 thank you again 😊

If you are thinking about booking, do it! My husband and I had a great experience making 3 types of pasta with chefs Emanuel and Angelo. They made everyone very comfortable, with their clear instructions we made wonderful tasting ravioli, fettuccine and gnocchi 😋 we even had a surprise dessert and our own chef hats 😃 there was a very cheerful vibe for the entire experience, the small group setting made it much more enjoyable. Highly recommend when you are in Rome to do with your loved ones! 🥰

The most magical evening in Rome. Emanuele and Angelo are both gems. Full of talent passion and love for their art, they exuded this over the course of 3 hrs so we too could become pasta chefs for an evening!!
Emanuele made this a really special experience. Had a ton of fun, made delicious pasta and learned the whole process. Recommend to everyone.

To truly experience the Italian culture you must understand it’s magnificent cuisine and this is experience is a must ! In addition to the terrific fresh pasta made by you (which is something unbelievable) you will also laugh and enjoy every minute of this experience. I am extremely happy that this type of experiences are available and you can’t miss it!
It was such a wholesome experience! Great atmosphere and tasty food. If you want to learn how to cook pasta from one of the best chefs in Rome book now!
A memorable experience to remember! The hosts were great and the pasta was incredible and much easier to prepare than one would think! Highly recommended for anyone considering it :)

Walking into this space felt like joining a dinner party with an incredible team of hosts! The space is incredible, the music is great, and then there is the main event: making pasta!!!

We had an intimate group of 12–including me and my 13 year old son. He was excited from the moment we got our aprons and went to our stations! And his excitement was met with an amazing experience—better than what I can describe! Chef Emanuele and his team are knowledgeable, personable, funny, and engaging! They made us feel like we would be able to make incredible pasta and with their care and individual attention, we did!!!

Each person had their own station and we were lead through making pasta step-by-step! We learned the benefits of rolling pasta with a rolling pin and how to roll it out to a beautifully thin sheet in preparation for making raviolis and fettuccine!!!

We made different types of pastas and were shown how to make different sauces, too! We ended the evening with an incredible tiramisu made right before our eyes!

The wine flowed as did the laughter! We left the experience with new skills, recipes, and tons of great memories!!! I highly recommend this experience!

This is a MUST book experience. We knew we wanted to experience a cooking class while in Rome + we stumbled upon this class, which had great reviews. WOW, this went above + beyond any expectations we had going in we had an incredible group of people from all over that we were chatted + laughed w for 3+ hours. Emanuele and Angelo were AMAZING, so personable and fun. And the food - wow the food was incredible. Learning the techniques and stories they told was truly and wonderful experience. Will definitely be back one day! Incredible
Super cool and educational event. Emanuele simply knows how to explain the intricacies of pasta making. The atmosphere is consistently great and you feel completely welcome!!

Emanuele and his team welcomed us in their cozy pasta factory where they introduced us to the world of pasta making. It was a great and fun experience and I will definitely come back whenever I am in Rome!
The experience was just amazing! Emanuele is such a kind person and showed us how to make the best pasta I’ve ever made myself! Don’t miss it! :)

Really fun pasta class with pretty easy-to-follow and informative instructions. Emanuele and Angelo are lovely people and very enthusiastic about their craft. They make you feel welcome AND feed you well!! Highly recommend!!

Emanuele and his team went above and beyond making us feel so accommodated with being Gluten Free. This is a must-do when being in Rome. A very approachable and knowledgeable experience for anyone wanting to have an amazing experience making pasta from scratch as the Roman’s do. From the recipes, wine, and explanations, this was easily the best experience we’ve had in Rome so far. It is a MUST!
Had a super fun workshop, with great hosts. Really enjoyed! Highly recommended if you're in Rome, a fantastic evening is guaranteed!

Good introduction to pasta making with practice learning how to make noodles and a few shapes by hand. Chefs take the pasta and make professional restaurant-level food to enjoy at the end. As a professional chef, I learned a new way to roll pasta sheets by hand. Everything else is a fairly standard pasta class. Overall a great value and great for beginners.

Emanuele and Angelo gave us a professional, friendly and unforgettable experience. They were really able to do everything bilingual (French and English) to ensure a good understanding of all.

Gluten-free adaptations were just as simple and integrated.

I had the chance to cook and eat gluten-free dumplings and gluten-free fettucinis under the supervision of Emanuele and Angelo. I felt like a real chef for a night out. I feel confident about replicating everything at home.

One of the best experiences you will ever do! The chefs are incredible with their knowledge and patience
The ambience was fantastic! The sauces the chefs added to the pasta we made were astounding! DO NOT MISS OUT ON THIS EXPERIENCE
This was such a fun experience! the chefs are wonderful, love the energy and learned so much about pasta making, definitely a must do when in Rome!

Emanuele and Angelo were amazing teachers!! They welcomed us into their kitchen with open arms, a wealth of knowledge, and a great sense of humor. By the end of the class we felt like pros and can’t wait to try Emanuele’s family recipes at home!!
Emanuele was a great host and excellent teacher! We had such a good time pasta making and will definitely be recommending this experience to friends visiting Rome.
amazing class with an amazing chef! learnt 3 different types of pasta and enjoyed every bit of the experience. would 100% recommend when in Rome!

INCREDIBLE class with an incredible instructor! Emanuele was full of energy and warmth and taught us how to make the best pasta with different types of sauce, and it all felt so easy. We are so happy we took this class and cannot recommend it enough!

Emanuele was a great host and a thoughtful teacher. He carried out such an engaging and fun class that got us excited for what was next. We can’t wait to try what we learned back home! Highly recommend for anyone that wants to learn more about pasta making or anyone looking to have a fun group activity! And the pasta we made was some of the best we had in Rome!

it was such a fun evening from beginning to end. Emanueleand his assistant were very hands on and encouraging during the making of pasta. Very organized and well prepared. Felt very at home. Pastas turned out great. Group was just the right size.

One of our most magical experiences our whole 2 week trip in Italy. Please do not hesitate to do this class. There is a reason for the amazing reviews. Emanuel and Angelo were fantastic, food was great and we met new friends. Grazie!

I have never done a cooking class before and I was a bit wary of whether it would be worth it. I was proved very wrong as this was an incredible experience. The two chefs were warm, funny, encouraging and I loved learning about the history of of the ingredients. Emanuele does a fantastic job at bringing together everyone else doing the class with you. I could not recommend this experience higher for anyone visiting Rome.

Book this as part of your trip!!! Loved spending time with Emanuele and Angelo learning how to make pasta, gnocchi, sauce, ravioli filling, and what to do with leftover pasta so it doesn’t go to waste :) we wined and dined afterwards and it was so much fun!
Emanuele is a star teacher in the art of pasta making. The class was well structured, informative, and a lot of fun. It made our time in Rome even more wonderful - and the meal was excellent!

This was a really great experience. Great teachers and a fun setting while learning how to make several types of pasta. It was really engaging and fun. My friends and I had a really good time in this class. Thanks!

amazing amazing amazing. don't even think about it, just book. by far the best experience in Italy, and we have done quite a few. we learned techniques we'll be able to recreate at home, met amazing people and just had so much fun. amazing location and ambience. highly recommend!
This is a must do if your in rome and want to embrace the true Italian culture. I couldn’t have asked for anything more. The whole day was fabulous. I will be back !!

This is a MUST!! The pasta lab was absolutely fantastic. You can tell they genuinely love teaching people and making new friends! Whether you’re a novice or experienced cook, you’ll make amazing homemade pasta. We were a group of 7, and it was one of the highlights of our trip. Book this now, you will be so happy you did!!

We had an amazing time in this pasta class. We learn how to make a whole bunch of different types of fresh pasta and what the differences are between them. We then learned how to make a delicious tomato sauce and then were shown how to make Cacio e Pepe as well (which I'd tried before at home and never succeeded).
Emanuele is an amazing host and would absolutely recommend a class with him to anyone
This experience was fantastic and I’d definitely recommend it! Emanuele and Angelo were so passionate, friendly and knowledgable. We learned loads and enjoyed our tasty pasta!
10/10 recommend, my experience was amazing. Between the ascetics and good music that was being played vibes were through the roof. This is the experience you want to go with for sure.
Superb experience!! Friendly and educational. I recommend 1000% the talent and knowledge of Emanuele! A little extra for the personal touch for my friend's birthday 🤩

An awesome experience meeting the Chefs and the dedication of one on one experience. Listening to music, enjoying watching how others were creating their masterpiece. It was so special to sit a nice square table where we could converse, drink wine and ask questions. We got to see the making of Carbonara right at our table and and at the end tiramisu being made at our table. So nice to enjoy eating what we personally made. I will come back again and again. Jon and Andrew

What a fantastic way to spend a late morning/early afternoon in Rome! Such a great experience and Emanuele and Angelo were both great. I highly recommend this experience. After the event they even booked us a taxi so we could get to our next destination in time.

My daughter and I booked this experience and it was one of the highlights of our trip to Rome. We loved spending time at the Pasta lab … everything was perfect…the environment, the music, the chefs (Emanuele and Angelo), learning how to make pasta and the meal was delicious 🤤. Must do if you are in Rome 👌🏼. Highly recommended!!

This pasta making class was nothing short of amazing. The hosts were so kind to us and helpful. We were running late because of traffic and they made me and my husband feel so welcome when we did arrive. (Give yourself plenty of time to get to event).

We were able to make a few different types of pasta, the chefs then cook it for you and serve it to you in a sauce that they show us how to make.

We were also given wine, Champaign, and later some tiramisu for dessert.

I would book this again in a heartbeat. The pasta i made was by far the best pasta i had in Italy. Just absolutely so much fun.

I’ve been 11 times to Rome and every time I try a new experience. This is by far the best experience I’ve ever had! The class exceeded my expectations. The chefs are amazing and super friendly! Emanuele is very funny and passionate about his work and it shows from his teaching methods. Top top top experience!! If you’re ever in Rome you gotta try it!

My husband and I signed up for this class as part of our honeymoon. It was a highlight in our trip to Rome and the pasta was honestly better than some of the restaurants we went to in Rome. Emanuele and his team provided a superb experience from each pasta we made to the end experience of tasting our hard work with his homemade sauces. The carbonara was better than famous Nannarella in our minds and the dessert Tiramisu was also so tasty and loved how non soggy it was! I hope to return in the future to take another class!

This cooking class is amazing! The 2 hosts create a very fun atmosphere with music and do a great job with teaching how to make pasta. They help answer any questions that you may have about the pasta making process and the pasta made in the class was delicious! We made ravioli with its filling and fettucine from scratch. We weren't involved in the actual cooking process of the pasta or the creation of the sauce. Would highly recommend this to any visitors of Rome!

It was a great & fun class! If you are in the area this is a must!
They were super friendly, personable and the overall experience was fantastic.

Emanuele and his team were fantastic hosts and teachers! This was a highlight of our honeymoon trip in Rome, we loved learning to make pasta and had a delicious meal with wonderful company and wine to top it off. We felt so happy to be in this class and recommend it to everyone that visits Rome! Thank you so much Emanuele and team for such a memorable experience! We hope to be back soon!

Me and my boyfriend did this together while in Roma and it was so much better than I would of expected. Our guide was so personable, informative, entertaining, and talented. I guess I didn't realize it's not that easy to make pasta, you learn how to make different kinds by hand -- eating handmade pasta in Rome isn't that easy to find so this lunch was one of the best meals I had! (you will learn the difference between dried/store bought, fresh, and handmade)
We learned how the sauces were made, but didnt make the sauces.

This was the best Airbnb experience we have ever done! Emanuele and Angelo have great energy and charisma. They are wonderful teachers & will help you along the way. Everything was structured and timed perfectly from the music, instructions, and food/wine. We have learned so much, and want to recreate their recipes at home some day!

Absolutely fantastic. The food is amazing, the hosts are incredibly interesting and entertaining, the whole place has a very intimate feel, and it’s decently cheap for what you get. 10/10, highly recommend.

Wow! What an amazing evening. The guys really knew how to make the time fun while learning some of the important techniques. The food was amazing, the way they teach was incredible and their energy was awesome. Highly recommend this for a great evening in Rome.
One of the best things we did in Rome! Highly entertaining, learned a lot about pasta and the food was absolutely delicious! Would definitely recommend!

Incredible experience! Emanuele is simply the best host. This really exceeded all of my expectations, it was so much fun! I can’t recommended this highly enough - it’s amazing. Great venue, great food, great wine, super friendly and accommodating hosts - and not to mention great pasta class! Definitely book this - you will not be disappointed!

Emanuele and Angelo were great hosts, they’re both extremely friendly and knowledgable. This experience was better than I could’ve imagined, with lots of fun and wine. I feel I have genuinely learnt a skill, and I will be saving the recipes given to me to try them out at home. 100% recommend doing this when in Rome!

Amazing! Authentic experience of learning how to make pasta and getting to know other people visiting Italy. The hosts were interactive and funny, sharing stories of their lives and what makes their class so special. Absolutely would recommend this class!

This experience is one of my favorite things we’ve done in Rome. Even though all the reviews are highly recommend the cooking class, I didn’t expect to love it as much as I did.

Emanuele and Angelo are so funny and passionate about what they do—and I learned so much about what makes good pasta. They made everything easy for people that had never made pasta before. The atmosphere was so lively with music playing the whole time, and it was nice to spend the evening with other people from around the world also visiting Rome.

After making the pasta, you get to eat a three different pasta dishes, drink wine, and end with a delicious dessert. It has been one the best meals I’ve had over my stay in Rome. This experience is so fun and such a good value, I cannot recommend it enough!

Highly Recommend. Emanuele and Angelo were very hospitable. We felt like we were invited to our friends' home. They were also very patient with our two children age 8 and 9. It was an unforgettable experience. The other guests were all very friendly and we enjoyed their company. You will not be disappointed.

I love the experience of pasta making ❤️ Emanuele and the team were super friendly, the pasta we made was delicious. Emanuele speaks English, Italian and French and was able to teach very international group of guests. Also, Emanuele will teach you how to make pasta by hands, not machine! Real experience. Loved it and Definitely recommend!

This is a must do experience and is worth more than 5 Micheline star experience. If you ever in Rome do not even look for other classes as this will be an unforgettable experience. Emanuel was very experienced organised and fun to learned with! We will definitely come back
Perfect class, very very engaging and for someone looking for a pasta course.... this is straight out of a culinary school, eased out for even newbies.

This class was a 12/10! It was so fun, engaging, and hands on. The instructors are so informative and have fun with the class. The playlist is also fire. You’ll be able to transition these skills to your kitchen because it requires zero equipment. Such a cool, unique experience and we HIGHLY recommend.

There’s a reason why this is the most popular pasta experience. Both chefs are passionate at what they do and you can tell. The organization and structure of the entire event was excecuted perfectly. Lovely night to end my time in Rome.

This pasta making course was great. Emanuele and Angelo walked us through the process and explained every step as we went. The pasta we produced was delicious and this is one cooking class that I know that I will use at home.

We had so much fun on this cooking class. It was amazing. Emanuele and Angelo are the best, they are super friendly and make the class very special. We learned how to make 3 delicious types of pasta. The atmosphere was excellent! We had great food, wine and company. I highly recommend this experience!!! You won’t regret it!

This was my favourite experience of my time in Rome. I learned a lot, laughed a lot, had great food and company.
Such a great way to learn how to make great pasta and the time flew by!

Came here on the day we landed in rome. It’s very close to Rome Termini (walking distance). Emanuele & Angelo were such a blast. It was a very informative & interactive class. Everything went smoothly. There was great music in the background. They explained & demonstrated every step, as well as background information on pasta. We had lots of wine and Prosecco too! Love eating family style with everyone sitting around the table eating together like one big family (we had individual plates). We met so many people from around the world. And our pastas tasted amazing!!! They made us dessert and it was was delicious too. Highly recommend. Please try this!

Such a wonderful class!
Emanuele and the team were so professional, entertaining and very knowledgeable about all things pasta!
It was a perfectly curated class and we absolutely loved it. Definitely recommend!

This cooking class was one of the best experiences we had in Rome! Emanuele, Angelo, and the rest of his team were patient, humorous, fun, and excellent teachers. We truly enjoyed the intimate dinner to follow-- eating our very own homemade pasta with wine to celebrate! 10/10 Recommend

There’s so much to do and see in Rome, but if you find the time, I highly recommend taking this class. This was hands down one of my absolute favorite parts of our trip. Emanuele and Angelo were helpful, patient, and super fun to work with. They made making pasta fun and easy. The best part was the lovely dinner afterwards and getting to eat the pasta you just made. 10/10

Emanuele and his team were amazing- the whole experience was extremely knowledgeable, thoughtful and organized. You can tell he cares about everyone’s experience and that it was top of mind throughout the evening. Emanuele went the extra step to explain more complex steps and was very accommodating to everyone in the group. Highly recommend as it was delicious, low stress and a ton of fun!

Emanuele and his team gave us a pasta night to remember! We booked this pasta cooking class for the first night we arrived in Rome and after that no pasta meal in the city could compare to what we made with him.
He was funny, knowledgeable, and accommodating.

We were a group of two and one of us is vegan. He made sure to have a completely separate cooking station and ingredients specifically for a vegan diet. The entire class was a small group of 12 from all over. We made pasta and friends throughout the evening.

We had the opportunity to make ravioli, fettuccini, tortellini and gnocchi. We made the pasta and fillings. He showed us how to make the sauces and told us how to cook them but his team did all of that (recipe cards were given to take home). The class primarily focused on the pasta part. We learned so much.

Thank you much for starting our Rome trip with a delicious evening of pasta, wine, and new friends!

This was the most fun way to end our time in Rome!!! Emanuele and his team are incredible teachers, and made the cooking class such a great experience for my husband and I. We made ravioli, tortellini, fettuccini, and gnocchi! The class was small and intimate, and we all got direct assistance in making our pasta from scratch. The group all had a blast and we would highly recommend this class for anyone looking to take a pasta making class in Rome!
Amazing experience! This was one of the highlights of my trip. I learned a lot (best teachers!), had fun and ate a delicious dinner with new friends. I’ll remember them every time I cook Italian!

Emanuele and Angelo were so kind! We had an amazing evening while making different sorts of fresh pasta, drinking wine, chatting with different people from all over the world and FINALLY eating our self made food. The amazing chefs prepared our pasta with the best sauces!

It was so much fun learning how to make pasta and it’s a great experience for everyone wishing to improve their cooking skills!
Such a delightful experience. This is a must on your trip to Rome. It was so fun to spend time learning from such a gracious and light hearted teacher. The food we made was delicious!

Highly recommend!!!

Emanuele was an amazing teacher, taught as all the tips and tricks about making pasta. The location is great and the 3 hour workshop past really fast because of the amazing energy!

Can’t wait to make my friends the recipes that Emanuele was so kind to share with us! ✨

This was the best experience! We were made to feel incredibly welcome by both Emanuele and Angelo who used our names all throughout. It was intimate and special! Just such nice people and a really informative and fun evening. I cannot fault it and I would recommend it to anyone! Thank you!

Emanuele and Angelo were exceptional!!! They guided us through all the steps to make an incredible handmade pasta 🍝!
Absolutely recommend this experience!! It’s the best souvenir you can get from Rome and Italy! Learning how to cook proper pasta with great local teachers and have a great time! The food was delicious, we also drink bubbles and red wine at dinner and a surprise and yum dessert!
You won’t regret it!!!

We had a wonderful time learning how to make pasta. This was the highlight of our stay in Rome. It was great to eat the pasta we made. We also enjoyed the cheeses, wines, and tiramisu. Emanuele and Angelo were awesome teachers - thanks for the amazing experience!
A highlight of our visit to Rome. Emanuele (and company) were incredibly knowledgeable and welcoming! We both learned new skills we’ll use at home. Don’t hesitate, book this experience!

We had a great time during this pasta making class! Very informative, and I feel like I could re-make some of the pastas at home. Everything was delicious, and the instructor were friendly and taught us so much about the technique and quality of everything we were making.
Grazie mille, Emanuele and Angelo for such an amazing experience! We had a blast making ravioli and fettuccine. We hope to come back to Rome soon to take your lasagna cooking class!

Exceptional experience to do in Rome
Learn from a chef like Emanuele making Italian pasta is an experience I recommend if you're going through this beautiful city
A real professional lab with a top team
Thanks again for a lovely meal

P.S. Thank you again for translating into French despite our foreign group

Emanuele and Angelo are the ultimate hosts! Energetic, insightful, and fun! Their pasta-making experience is such a great time. They’re endlessly patient, great teachers, and superb chefs! Their attention to detail and explanation of every part of the pasta-making process is excellent, and the final outcome is truly delicious. Cannot recommend highly enough!

You have no idea!!!! This is a MUST!!! These guys, Emmanuelle and Angelo are outstanding, kind, funny, lovely and thoughtful! They know what they are doing… the whole vibe, the place, music, timing, materials but specially… THEY!! Too bad there are only 5 stars to rate this experience, otherwise I would give a 100 stars! This was by far my favorite experience in town. They are experts, they are professionals and they know what they are doing and saying! they care about you having fun and a good time! If you want to deep in the tradition and learn about Italian cuisine, then this is your choice! They start giving you information about the pasta process making and basics… then we get all this hands on experience with they teaching us step by step and making it easy and understandable! The food was delicious, they gave us wine, Prosecco, water and everything we needed! 100% recommended!!

What a fantastic night and experience! The highlight of our trip to Rome! Far from the maddening crowds and the hot sun, this experience with Emanuele takes you back to the past, making pasta by hand. The setting was very peaceful and romantic. There were just 12 of us (my family was 5!), so we received individual attention and praise as we learned to get the pasta dough right. Surprisingly, with their expert instructions, we made delicious stuffed ravioli and fettuccine! While making the pasta, they had a helper go around and clean up the station, which we got pretty messy. Their instructions were excellent and entertaining. Emanuele was delightful! His partner, who was just as funny, showed us how the sauces were made! After making the pasta, we sat around a beautifully- set table, drank wine, and ate! Everyone there became friends and left there smiling and glad we came. There are other surprises throughout the evening, like freshly made cocoa pasta, but they are too numerous to mention. I highly recommend this experience! I guarantee you will be glad you did!
great experience! we loved it, and we really don't regret doing it. the best part of our trip!

This was simply one of the best things my husband and I did in Rome. It’s a smaller group so everything was very hands on and fun. Both Emanuele and Angelo were very passionate about teaching and really helped you understand what you were doing. The music, the mood, and the food were terrific. You have to book this experience!

Don't hesitate to book this pasta making class with Emanuele and his team! Great fun while learning from a wonderful chef. We did this with a family of 4 (including 2 young adults) and everyone said this was one of the best things we did during our vacation in Rome. Grazie Mille Emanuele!
Had the best experience! Absolutely loved this and highly recommend to everyone!! Well worth doing and loads of fun! Food is absolutely delicious

What a great experience! Emanuele and his team were super helpful and personable. The mood and atmosphere was joyful and intimate. And the pasta was life altering. Would highly recommend this experience!!

Great experience, with final tasting of the dishes we made. Now we know how to make pasta like top chefs!
And the tiramisu was delicious.
Amazing experience!! We learned so much and had a fabulous time. Chef and Angelo were fun and great teachers. We couldn’t recommend this more!!!
Emanuele is very nice and explains very well. We had a great time with her and learned a lot.
Everyone in our group loved this experience. Emanuele and Angelo were wonderful hosts and we could not have had a better time. It was the highlight of our trip to Rome. Highly recommended!
Delicious experience! I learned pasta from the best, the class is simple and suitable for all audiences, the best part is that the service was very good from the hosts and the food was delicious.

The best experience we could have had in Rome without hesitation! Emanuele and Angelo are great chefs, very patient and educational. They made us have an amazing time, from making pasta to sharing a meal (with good wine and a great group)
We will recommend this experience to anyone visiting Rome
A thousand thanks Emanuele and Angelo, you are perfect!

A great way to learn making pasta. Chefs Emanuele and Angelo clearly explained the traditional way of making hand made pasta with different types of sauces. They were patient and really funny as well. We had some prosecco, some vino, and we got to eat what we prepped. Overall, it was a very fun experience. Bellisimmo!

Emanuele and Angelo were great hosts. Their personality and eagerness to teach made this a very memorable experience. We got to watch demonstrations and then make several kinds of pasta. They were delicious and their hospitality was great. Would definitely recommend this experience. Easily our favorite thing we did in Rome!
Thank you so much for a great pasta experience! We had so much fun and the pasta was authentic and delicious :) -Emma and Spencer

Wow! Such a great evening learning about pasta, making it and eating it. Even had a delicious tiramisu at the end for dessert! Emanuele and Angelo were both excellent and it was a really fun environment with music and drinks. Probably the highlight of my trip to Rome, recommend for everyone.

We had a great time during the pasta workshop given by Emanuele and Angelo. Emanuele and Angelo are very pleasant hosts who create a great atmosphere during the pasta making. They are very helpful and attentive. Because of this, it was possible to accomplish everything successfully. I had never made pasta before and with the proper guidance, it turned out really good. Moreover, we were spoilt with a snack and a glass of prosecco during the making of the pasta. There was a nice ambience because of the music that was played during the workshop. We had our workshop on Thursday, which gave us the chance to taste some delicious gnocchi. The pasta was fantastic. I will definitely try to make it at home. Angelo and Emanuele also provided enough water and offered good red wine. Also the location was easy to reach. At the end of the workshop, Emanuele and Angelo even offered to call a taxi, which was very helpful. I thought it was a fantastic experience which I will remember with pleasure. It was cosy, charming and delicious, so all the ingredients for a successful evening were present. Book this experience if you are in Rome, you will not regret it! (And if you're still not convinced, book the workshop at least to taste Emanuele's fantastic tiramisu. I am still daydreaming about it ;-))

Emanuele was a super host. He was so welcoming to each and every person that walked into his prep kitchen. He did a wonderful job explaining each task we completed and kept the evening entertaining for the whole 3 hours. He has a lot of charisma and had a fantastic playlist of music playing in between instructions given to make our time in the kitchen fly by. I would highly recommend any friends travelling to Rome to check out Emanuele’s cooking class. Emanuele will not disappoint.
Emanuele and Augusto were excellent hosts. they helped me with gluten free pasta and me new techniques for pasta making. we throughly enjoyed class - highly recommend!

Emanuele is super friendly, along with Angelo, which made the pasta making process way more entertaining. Simple steps, and they’re very helpful and encouraging. Towards the end you get to taste your own hand made pasta with their sauce of home recipes. We even had a surprise tiramisu with peach!
Overall I would highly recommend this to everyone with all levels of pasta making skills!

Oh my goodness!!! This was the 5th Airbnb experience in 4 days…and by far our favorite. Emanuele made us instantly comfortable and welcome, and we felt like a part of the group immediately. He’s so knowledgeable and passionate about food and pasta…you just can’t help but get excited with him! His humor and positive teaching made this truly a once in a lifetime experience. If you have never been to Rome or have been many times…book this experience TODAY!!! Instead of trinkets or a t shirt, you will be taking away some great new skills to amaze your friends with…and what better way to learn than by learning from a true master.

Amazing pasta class! I highly recommend for a fun evening of pasta making, laughing and learning! At the end of the night you eat your creation with fellow classmates and enjoy wine and tasty tiramisu

Great experience! We had a great time with Emanuele, her team, and the guests. Emanuele is passionate, exciting and with a lot of humor! Do not hesitate for a second: we leave with wonderful memories and know-how for pasta!
The pasta making class and dinner was amazing !! The staff make you feel comfortable and engaged. The vibe is super positive and the dinner was delicious!!! Highly recommend!

We just spent a great fun afternoon with Emanuele and Angelo. Fantastic company, kitchen set up and super tasty food. Highly recommended for families with teenagers - they stay engage and love their food. Thank you so much for this great evening.

This was exactly what we were looking for in a one of a kind experience - we learned a ton of new tips for cooking pasta, we ate some amazing food, they provided able wine to go with it, and Emanuele's charisma was second to none. He's for sure going to have a TV show one day (soon), so book this experience now while you can!

We had a fantastic experience, Emanuele and Angelo made everything perfect! Their consideration for gluten intolerance was far above what we expected. We highly recommend this pasta cooking master class!

Where do I begin? First of all Emanuele and Angelo are so warm and welcoming, they make you feel at home the moment you arrive, they gave everyone all the help and tips we needed while cooking and they created this super fun atmosphere with their charisma and warmth. At the end we got to taste the pasta we made with a glass (or two) of wine and they made us a delicious Tiramisu for dessert.
Definitely a highlight of our trip to Rome. Highly Recommend if you want to experience Italy to the fullest!
We had a great time and learned so much! 100% recommend this experience - Emanuele and Angelo are great at what they do. You will not be disappointed!

Great surprise! This was my first cooking class and I loved it from start to finish.
Emanuele and Angelo are very good chefs, By sharing their expertise, they share their passion for cooking and pasta with us! All with a touch of humor.
We highly recommend:)

Very good atmosphere. Emanuele is her companions have made the experience captivating, interesting and surprising. As the first cooking courtyard, they shared their knowledge and expertise.
I would highly recommend it:).

AMAZING activity. Angelo and Emanuele have a great approach. Obviously, they love what they're doing and want to share it. This is one of the best activities we've ever had during our stay (and the best tiramisu in Italy). Not to be missed under any circumstances!
What a great experience! Emanuele and her brigades make this experience unforgettable! Making pasta is so simple! I recommend it as a priority as an activity in Rome!!!
This was such a fun night on our honeymoon. Thorough teaching, super fun atmosphere with music playing and delicious food at the end!!

Fantastic evening - highly recommend booking. Emanuele and Angelo were great hosts, very knowledgeable and excellent teachers. We really appreciated that we got to understand not just the techniques but the reason why they are important.

I took my 10 yro daughter to the Professional Lab for the three-hour Italian cooking lesson. We both had a blast.

Our two hosts were relaxed, extremely patient and more importantly, fun and funny. They went beyond just showing you how to cook; they took the time to explain the history and processes of Italian cooking.

Our small class size (about 10) made it intimate and lively. We would definitely return.
We had so much fun with this class! The hosts were very friendly, and the space felt like a real culinary school! Great class for beginners, too.
Loved every moment. Was super lucky to have a small group where everyone got along. One of the best experiences I had in Italy
If you want to have some fun and learn something you can actually take home with you and use when you are back, then this is the experience for you. Great atmosphere that everyone can enjoy together.
This is the most fun and useful cooking class experience ever. 23 year old son said we have to give them a review, because it was fantastic. The whole family loved it.

My husband and I went to Rome and we decided to take a pasta class. It was a great experience! Love Emanuele and his team, they were so knowledgeable of their craft. Making the pasta was so much fun and the food was delicious.

Book now! Amazing experience. Chefs were excellent. The whole thing was fantastic from start to finish. Clean, safety conscious (thanks for the knife skills lesson!), and all with a lovely sense of humor. I can’t believe I made something that tasted so good!!! Gratzi, gratzi, gratzi!!
We had an absolutely amazing time! We learned so much about the art of pasta! We absolutely recommend anyone to take this class! Was a true highlight of our trip to Italy

Great experience with very good energy from both chefs.
Only negative was there were 14 of us, although the listing explicitly states a max size of 9. It was also an odd start as we arrived and there were no seats for us, as a double booking error had happened. However, I found this odd as even if we had not shown up, it still would have had 12 people and not the 9 as stated.
All that said, my wife and I still had a great experience and would highly recommend this to anyone in Rome.
Pasta lab experience was one of the highlights of our Rome stay! Thank you chef Emanuele for the amazing class and food and memories. It was remarkable.

Emanuele and his staff were absolutely wonderful hosts! This is not the sort of thing I would ever seek out (my wife booked), but I had an amazing time! Emanuele and Angelo could have their own TV show! They were so entertaining and informative. You can truly tell these guys have a passion for the culinary arts. Super informative, super fun, 10/10 would recommend!

This class was extremely worth while and one of the highlights of our trip. We’ve made homemade pasta prior to this, but this class brought it to a new level and we took away some major lessons/hints from this! It was very fun to interact with others groups that signed up. There is AC in the building but when it’s hot outside, it seems to struggle just a bit to keep up (if you’re booking this to get out of heat, it’s definitely better than outside but not cool/refreshing). Overall, it was an exceptional class and we can’t wait to try out these new methods we learned!

Incredibly fun and special! You make several pastas (with a little Prosecco and cheese to snack on) then eat the fruits of your labor - enhanced by the professional sauces. You leave with recipes and memories!

Wow. I signed up for the pasta class for our trip to Rome last minute and it was SO worth it! Emanuel is so friendly and makes everyone feel so welcome, no matter your skill level when it comes to cooking. Being able to learn all about the art of pasta making from him was amazing, and it was even better to enjoy eating our creations at the end. Emanuel’s tiramisu at the end was a fabulous way to end the class. Do yourself a favor and sign up!

Emanuele and his team were great hosts and helpful teachers. Highly educative course, well put together and never boring. Clear demonstration and practical steps that were easy to follow. Lovely atmosphere with music, wine&snacks. The course ended in a great meal around the table were we ate the pasta we made. Can be recommended to anyone, regardless of former kitchen experience.

Wonderful experience! Emanuele and Angelo create a true immersive experience -- we lost track of time as we learned how to make pasta and gnocchi. The event is well choreographed and extremely well paced with well-placed breaks for prosecco, cheese and informative teaching breaks. The music was fun (thanks to DJ Angelo) and the atmosphere felt kind of like a party! I was delighted to find that our classmates were Italians, two women who live in Rome (one of whom was a repeat student). In other words, it's a real class! There is a lot of hands-on time, something that sets this class apart from another class I took in Italy on the same trip. We learned a lot and because we did everything ourselves (and we weren't rushed), our entire family feels confident to try pasta at home. I want to add that Emanuele and Angelo are very kind and patient with children! They are very patient and indulged my 7 year old, letting him hang out in the kitchen to watch pasta cook and allowing him to make his own creations such as pasta paper airplanes. My kids (ages 7-15) LOVED this experience and hugged Emanuele and Angelo when we left. I don't think I would bring children under the age of 7 unless you are OK with your child potentially just playing with pasta dough (and that is ok too - it was OK with us). This experience was worth every cent (actually it's worth more).

Emanuele and his pasta making experience is a MUST do while in Rome. This authentic pasta making class will leave you with a true Italian food experience and you get to eat the food that you make after!!!
You have to do this pasta lab! Excellent from start to finish. Emanuele is so passionate about making pasta and the entire experience is top notch.
What a wonderful experience and great time! Emanuele and his other chefs made everything so much fun! They made me realize that pasta was something that I could truly make at home!!!

Incredible experience!
Emanuele and his team are so kind, driven, attentional and well organized. The place was above our expectations. The meal was incredibly good (the best pastas we had in Italy) and simply made with a few ingredients. Everybody can participate, the tasks are easy to achieve. Good vibe, ambiance and music!

We had a fantastic time in Emanuele's pasta class, it was our favorite experience in Rome! The class was very accommodating to our vegan diet as we made dry pasta with no eggs and they also made a separate tomato sauce for us. We really appreciated that we could still participate and we learned a lot to make pasta at home! It was a really fun experience.
Emanuele and Angelo did a terrific job. My family of four loved the class! The three hours flew by because we were having such a good time!

Grazie, Emanuele! This was perfect experience! My family loved your pastificio! Even my son who is only 4 years old (we thought he will be bored, but he had such a great time) enjoyed! I can’t wait to prepare pasta following your recipes! We had fun, learn a lot and went home with big smiles! This is an experience we will repeat!

This pasta making experience was nothing short of amazing thanks to Emanuele and Angelo!! Although the class size was bigger than expected, they made the whole class very personal but learning each of our names very quickly as well as allowing us time to drink and talk to the other guests. They also made the experience really fun by playing music and were super helpful and informative while making the pasta!! My friends and I absolutely loved this pasta making class and will definitely take what we learned and apply it once we are home!!

Exceptional experience, Emanuele and Angelo pay personal attention to each guest to help them learn how to make pasta. Good music, wine and a good crowd along with the chance to learn how to make pasta - what more could you ask for

Highly recommend

Whether you’re a first-timer or a many-timer to Rome, make sure you add this to your itinerary! Emanuele and Angelo are exceptional hosts and teachers and their love of pasta (and food) is contagious. The three hours flies by as you learn how to make the best fresh pasta, and wonder how you’ll cook it from a packet ever again! Thank you for the warm hospitality and unforgettable experience.
Nice experience that I recommend... unforgettable evening... easy to make pasta yourself now☺️... beautiful moment of sharing with other guests thanks to Emanuele and his team ☺️

Oh my goodness, this has been our favorite thing we have done this whole trip. Emanuele and his team we fun, gracious, and patient. They are great teachers. What a fun way to experience food. Do yourself a favor and book this experience.

The location is charming and really well organized for the hands-on pasta class. We had a great time making and hand-rolling fresh pasta and learned a simple way to make a great tasting cacio e pepe. Emanuele and his colleagues are friendly and explained the techniques clearly.

Fantastic experience!
We enjoyed it so much together! First we learned how to make it and then enjoyed best pasta in out lives. Emanuele was great, very pleasant host and very patient teacher as his assistant Angelo. Great atmosphere! We warmly recommend it!
P.S. I must mention that the best dessert, for 7 days that we spent in Rome, was Emanuel's Tiramisu 😍

My husband and I took this class and came away truly knowing how to make pasta. Emanuele is very charismatic and shares his love for making pasta in such a fun upbeat manner. If you are looking for a true Italian experience then this is the one for you.

Easily book again in a heartbeat!! Fantastic experience with Emanuele in his pasta class. He has such passion for teaching this class and I was so impressed with not just how the pasta process went but also in that every detail was tended to. Everything was super clean, the space is modern and fun. There wasn't a moment of just standing around wondering what's next... It was just beautifully choreographed. And the value is excellent. If you're a female booking, I'd recommend the mid day class if you're walking to and from just since you're a little off the train station, but don't let that deter you from booking. Seriously, it's fantastic!!!

What can I say about this experience other than "wow"! The hosts are just incredible people who are some of the most passionate, supportive teachers I've ever met. As the saying goes, you normally have to marry into the Italian family to get the secrets, but not with Emanuele! Everyone is welcome, supported, and encouraged, even when someone accidentally cuts their noodles in half. For beginners, for pro's, this class is legitimately for everyone.
This was an amazing experience! We learned so much about pasta making and our teachers made the experience fun and educational. I highly recommend this experience to anyone!
Wow! I could not have been more impressed with the set up, the orchestration, the professionalism and the level of service. You will leave having made the best pasta of your trip to Italy.

This was a highlight to our trip in Rome. Emanuele and his staff not only provided us with guidance in learning how to make pasta, they also provided great entertainment. We learned, laughed, danced, drank wine, and ate the best pasta I've ever had! Book early as this event will sell out. A big thank you to Emanuele and his team for an amazing evening!
What a grate experience. Emanuele and his team make je feel comfortable and provide a pleasant experience with music, wine and lots of pasta. It is really recommended.

Assignment completed, and much more! Not only did I learnt-and I managed to make homemade pasta, but I made it with a warm, relaxed, and friendly atmosphere. Emanuele is playful and generous, and has a real knack for teaching! His explanations are clear, and he and his colleague Angelo kindly supervise and encourage us! Add to this good music, prosecco, and a well-drunk dinner to enjoy our creations with people from all over the world. Plus, we left with the recipes! I had a really good time!
It was a great experience learning how to make pasta from Emanuele! He is a great teacher and truly cares about guests. The food was also amazing, better than most of the pastas I’d eaten in Rome!
Amazing pasta-making experience with a focus on technique. Lots of food and wine for everyone and we all left feeling so full. Highly recommend!
Wonderful experience. It was easy to understand and follow the steps, hard to master and get perfect, thus leading to the perfect balance of a good experience.

Emanuele and Angelo were personable, inviting, and funny, and they broke down the art of homemade pasta making into simple steps that anyone, even I, could follow. In addition, the pasta that was cooked for us afterwards was legitimately one of the best we ate across our entire Italy trip.

Super fun, hands-on experience!

Emanuele shows you how to make pasta in a professional but also funny way! You'll have a lot of fun preparing the pasta but you'll also enjoy the food at the end with wine:)
Awesome, we can just recommend it!

This was superb. Emanuele was funny and engaging. It was fun to learn to make pasta and amazing to have a professional guiding the process! This was a major highlight in my visit to Rome. Highly recommend to folks who love food and especially to those who have never made pasta from scratch.

We did this while in Rome for our honeymoon and it was one of the best experiences! We were either learning, laughing or eating the whole time. Emanuele was a great host and helped when we needed it. 10/10 experience!
We LOVED this class with Emanuele! Everything was great. We will be happy to recommend to our friends and family if they are coming for a walk in Rome.

Emanuel’s class was a wonderful cooking class, both informative and interesting. He is very nice and makes you feel welcomed. We took our 14 yr old son and 16 yr old daughter and they both really enjoyed it, as did my husband and I. Food was delicious! Highly recommend this experience.
Emanuele made us feel at home! He remembered our names, had an amazing playlist throughout the class and taught a us to make the best pasta! Totally highlight of our trip!

This was a great experience. If you love pasta or want to know more about it, this is for you. Hands on pasta making with an energetic and engaging instructor and a wonderful staff. There is an opportunity to meet other travelers. Come with an appetite!

Emanuele was a energetic and comedic host. He showed each guest attention and seemed very genuine. The instruction was good and the food tasted great. There was also plenty of wine and limoncello to finish off the meal. A very good time!

Wow what can I say, BOOK this cooking class if you’re staying in Rome! Was one of the most special and fun nights my husband and I shared on our entire trip! Emanuele is so fun and energetic and goes through the whole process of making pasta from beginning to end so thoughtfully! We learned so much but still had fun while doing it! They had music playing in the background, gave us wine, and at the end you get to eat the pasta you yourself made and it was seriously some of the best pasta I’ve ever had! He also gives you all the recipes which is amazing so hopefully we can go home and make it again! Will never forget this experience, definitely recommend!

We had such a fab time making pasta with. Emanuele! Emanuele made the whole process so simple and it was such a unique opportunity to learn from the best in pasta making. The experience was definitely a highlight of our time in Rome. Would definitely recommend to foodies!

Emanuele was an outstanding host. We left feeling happy that we participated in his class. Him and Angelo made sure everyone was having fun and constantly encouraged us through any difficulties. We also met some great people who also participated in the class. Would absolutely recommend this experience to anyone looking to a do a pasta making class on a visit to Rome. This has to be the best offering in the city. Thanks Emanuele!!

Such a fantastic evening and experience. For the value, you get much more than you pay for. You learn so much about pasta making, sauce, the story telling. The host is charming, upbeat, and friendly all while being an expert in this craft. The food is tasty and a lot, lots of wine, great music, and such an enjoyable event!
Emanuele’s class/experience is simply amazing. His passion for cooking and making sure everyone is having a good time is evident. If you are in Rome, this is a must stop!

Really fun and educational pasta workshop!

I've done pasta workshops before so I already knew a little bit about how to make pasta, but I definitely learned new things and tricks. Emanuele and Angelo are great hosts and Emanuele is an absolute pro at fun teaching. Everything was extremely well organised too and there was someone helping out with keeping everything clean while we prepared the food.

The setting is in a professional kitchen, the group was quite big and the whole workshop is choreographed to the smallest detail, so there isn't that much room for individual attention and questions. I think I personally prefer something a littler smaller scale and homey, but this was incredibly well done and will be just the right thing for most people!

Emanuele was also really considerate in placing me next to the one other person who was there by themselves, which was really nice. He also made sure that one of the participants, who didn't speak much English, understood everything by translating the most important bits into French.

Highly recommended. You will learn to make the intricacies of the pasta that you cannot transfer via digital media.
There is plenty of personal attention and Emanuel and his team are very welcoming.
Emmanuel is attentive to everyone and communicates the workshop in a clear and enjoyable way. Suitable for all participants. And the meal at the end of Delicates.

This is experience is ABSOLUTELY not to be missed!!! Emanuele and his team create an experience perfectly balanced among learning, doing, laughing, celebrating, and feasting. Pasta will never be the same! This evening is a favorite memory of our time in Rome, and we could not more highly recommend this experience.

Really enjoyed the pasta making class with Emanuele and his team! They made the experience really accessible to those that may know nothing about making pasta and you'll come away learning lots of great little things that you can take back home with you. Time really flew by with how much fun this class was. Would highly recommend if you have a free evening in Rome to take this class
We had so much fun at our pasta class! Emanuele was so fun - our family of five all had such a great time. Will definitely be making pasta with homemade sauce at home. A great memory from our trip!

I was blown away by how much fun I had with this experience. It was beyond phenomenal every second.
Highly recommend booking this.
Emanuele went above and beyond with entertainment, delicious entrees, and was the friendliest in all of Rome. He and his team even assisted us in procuring a taxi for the evening.
Will definitely be revisiting soon.

Book this! Emanuele's pasta making experience was such a unique cooking class. You walk away with real world knowledge of pasta making and recipes to put to use at home in a very entertaining, small group setting.

We had the best time at the pasta making class! Emmanuel and the team were really friendly, knew everyone’s names and were just really lovely to be around. The pasta was delicious and the whole evening was amazing. I would definitely recommend.
Fantastic class, definitely a highlight of our trip. The class was so fun and educational and the food was beyond delicious. 10/10 recommend!
One of our favourite experiences, not just during this trip to Rome, but in all of our trips. The time flew by and Emanuele and Angelo were fantastic! Cannot recommend more highly.

I had high expectations coming into this experience and they were definitely met by Emanuele and his team. The experience was very hands on from start to finish and Emanuele/his team provided real time feedback to each person, every step of the way. All instructions were delivered clearly and with humor. The team also went above and beyond for me in making sure I was ok after getting a bit lightheaded from the Prosecco :)

Emanuele, Angelo and the team at Pastificio Faini are absolutely delightful!!! My sister and I are visiting Rome for the first time, and we were so happy to take part in this wonderful cooking class. We learned so many techniques and everything was so great. The class is perfect for anyone wanting to enjoy a perfect evening with an inspiring local. Toda raba, Emanuele and team!!

We had the best experience with Emanuele and his class - one of our favorite memories of our 2 week Italy honeymoon!! Do not miss your chance to book a class with him! He was knowledgeable and patient with everyone as they made their pasta - and also made it fun and engaging! It also helped that everything we made was absolutely delicious (yes, you eat everything you make afterwards) and simple to do. We’re already looking forward to using the recipes at home! We could not recommend this experience enough to anyone who hasn’t (or has) done a pasta making class!!

My husband and I have booked many Airbnb experiences over the years. This is, by far, the best one yet. And of all the amazing things we did in Italy, this was absolutely the highlight of our trip. Emanuele is a phenomenal host and teacher, with a true love and passion for his craft. He made each of us feel welcome and competent at a skill that we were all trying for the first time. The environment was fun and inviting, and the experience of hand-making our own pasta was unlike any other. And then to eat the pasta that we made? Fantastic. He even went out of his way to make sure there would be a gluten-free option available for me, which I appreciate so much. (For anyone else who needs to eat GF, I do not have celiac, just a high intolerance to gluten, yet I found myself still able to eat the normal pasta without getting sick! I didn't feel perfect, but significantly better than I've ever felt after eating regular pasta. Emanuele does have a GF option though, if you cannot consume any gluten.)

I would recommend this experience 1000x over. We will definitely book this again next time we return to Rome!

Emanuele’s cooking class was the best part of our trip to Italy! His passion for pasta is evident and he is super knowledgeable about it. We had tried various pasta dishes while in Italy before attending his class and I can honestly say the pasta from his pasta lab was the best we have had! His ingredients are so simple and the techniques he teaches you allows you to get the authentic Italian pasta taste and texture. The pasta we made in his pasta lab was so clean tasting that you could eat it multiple times a day and still feel healthy! He teaches you about his family’s pasta sauce recipe, which is the best tomato based sauce we have tasted and it was so simple, it was life changing! We went on a Tuesday so Emanuele also taught us how to make the cacio e pepe sauce, which was absolutely delicious and it is all in the technique because it utilized like only 3 ingredients. I loved how his class was suitable for cooks of all types of skill levels. I would say I am a fairly experienced home cook and I found it enjoyable and I learned some new things. My husband cannot cook at all (like he can use the microwave and that’s about it) and he enjoyed the class because Emanuele’s instructions were simple and he shows you what to do before you have to cook and he provides assistance and guidance throughout the whole class so my husband had no trouble keeping up. There was music playing in the class and we got Prosecco and wine and cheese, it was like a fun party more than a cooking class. It was so nice that we got to sample the cheese we would be cooking with and it was such good quality ingredients. I highly recommend this experience to everyone and I wish I had booked this earlier in my trip so that I can go back for a second class, it was just that good!

This was a very fun and educational pasta making class! Emanuele is a great teacher and brought a lot of energy and humor to the class. It was also fun meeting and chatting with the other guests. If you have a free night in Rome, definitely book this experience!

This experience was by far my favorite part of my trip to Rome! The instructors were funny and helpful, and we had an amazing time making different kinds of pasta! Super yummy to eat your creation and now we’ll have to make homemade pasta all the time!

This experience was just wonderful! We booked the day before by luck, but we recommend booking ahead of time in busier months. Emanuele was incredible. He was informative, welcoming (like an old friend), funny, and a great teacher. The space was clean and intimate and the group wasn't to big which we loved. It was neat actually, as the group consisted of all couples around the same age, so for our honeymoon it was so fun meeting other couples from around the world while making and eating our own pasta. This was one of our favorite days on our honeymoon due to how fun, welcoming, and interactive this experience was. I have been to Italy before and tried many cooking classes, however, this one was by far my favorite!

Emanuele was incredible! This pasta class was a wonderful way to learn more about Italian cuisine. He's an incredible teacher, the food turned out fantastic and it was just the right amount of teaching and doing. We loved every minute of it and will definitely come again the next time we're in Rome!

What an amazing experience! The team had a perfect balance of storytelling and giving us hands-on experience. Lots of tips and tricks I'll be taking home, especially since we were given recipes - not only for what we made but also other suggestions to try out. And the final product was probably the best pasta I've ever had!
We had the best time ever making pasta with Emanuele. A must do when you visit Italy ! Your pasta game will never be the same and your belly will ask you to come back !

Emanuele was an amazing host and it was one of the most memorable experiences of our trip! He has extensive knowledge of pasta and patiently teaches you step by step on how to make the best quality pasta available. It was one of the best carbonara I have ever tried. I would recommend this experience to anyone coming to Rome, its a must do!

Emanuele went above and beyond to teach and interact with everyone in the group. He is incredibly knowledgeable about pasta and funny keeping his teachings light hearted. We ate, drank and shared stories about our travels. Highly recommend!

It was my first pasta cooking class and I think I really learned how to make the most delicious pasta ever!! Also the vibe was really nice, good music, wine and delicious sauces! Emanuele is also a very friendly and entertaining host who also took time to really help you.

I have done a few cooking experiences in Rome and this one was the best one by far! Emanuele, Angelo and the rest of the team exceeded all expectations, they were so professional, friendly and helpful. Me and my boyfriend loved every minute of this experience… it is a must if you are in Rome!!

I was even free to observe his back-end kitchen techniques cooking the pasta you just made as we talked shop.

Emanuel also had a wonderful personality and was friendly and upbeat. You get personalized service due to a minimally controlled class size, and was an excellent host.

For those looking for a professionally run pasta class that's perfect for both a pro, or someone looking for a fun experience to expand their culinary repertoire, this is the class for you.
