We had a great time! Pasta making was fun and eating it afterwards was delicious. Emanuele was very engaging throughout the experience. 5 stars all around!
Highly recommend this for anyone looking to do a cooking class in Rome! Emanuele is brilliant - he super knowledgeable and keeps the session really fun and easy to follow.

We had a great time in Emanual’s pasta class. It was cool that everyone gets their own pasta station in the kitchen and all of the ingredients that they need. His instructions are great and it’s easy to follow, yet making the pasta is challenging at the same time. I’ve tried making pasta at home before to varying degrees is success, but it’s great having an expert guiding you. Particularly with rolling it super thin and evenly. I can’t wait to go home and make ravioli! After making the pasta, you get to enjoy it in the dining room with wine. You won’t be hungry after! I’d recommend this class to anyone visiting Rome.
We're thrilled with Emanuele's course! Very nice experience. Looking forward to using what bees have learned to make lovely pasta at home 🤩

100% recommend. This experience was absolutely amazing!

Emanuele was superb! He was super helpful, very friendly, funny, and personable which made the experience! In addition to that, the food was to die for and the cooking technique was easy to understand and replicate. We had an absolute blast! Will definitely come again next time I am in Rome.

Such a great experience , I am not a cook but the lesson was so much fun that I truly enjoyed my experience and will definitely come back to take another class. I am looking forward to make pasta at home in the USA. My previous cooking experience was making ice cubes.

I have taken many classes around the world. Some crafts people know their art but are poor instructors; some teachers connect with their students but don't have (much) firsthand experience with the topic. Emanuele is the rare genius who knows his art top to bottom and yet is personable and engaging with all who enter his studio. I don't normally write reviews of products or experiences but I felt compelled to do so in this case.

Emanuele's love of food is plain to see, and it is exceeded only by his desire to share his passion with others. I would HIGHLY recommend this class to everyone. In our group was a gentleman who had *NEVER* cooked before -- he even had difficulty cracking an egg. Yet with Emanuele's instruction and guidance he was competently making hand rolled, hand cut amazing pasta by the end of the night. For those who may be proficient home cooks, you'll pick up tips and tricks to help up your game. If you want to learn pasta making from the source, i.e., a professional Italian chef, you have found the right experience!!! I'm sure Emanuele will blush when he reads this, as he's quite modest. But there are simply not enough superlatives to do his class justice.
Learned a lot about pasta, ate some delicious pasta, and gained the confidence to start making pasta on my own. Had a great time at it, too. Thank you Emanuele!
The pasta making experience was super fun and Emmanuel is so warm and personable. I thoroughly enjoyed the whole experience and would recommend to anyone!

Difficult to express in words how much my family enjoyed this course- surprised my parents (longtime chefs and foodies) with the experience and we couldn't have enjoyed it more. Emanuele was kind, attentive, jubilant, and an exception chef AND teacher - a rare combination. Hats off to him, and book the course immediately if you can get a slot!

What an amazing experience, nothing else to say, I cannot recommend it enough !!
The 1000+ positives reviews this experience has are all worth it. Thank you Emanuele for sharing your craft with such passion in an amazing set up.

Feel free to push the doors of Emanuele who welcomed us wonderfully! His passion and smile complements this beautiful experience to be able to make and then enjoy his own pasta! An activity that allowed us to meet people from other countries, a real pleasure that these 3 hours spent by them! In short, a unique experience, go without so much as a second thought!

we came here on our last day in Rome. This is our first cooking class, we are not sure what to respect. upon arrival, Emanuele gave us a warm welcome and shortly we started the class at the very beautiful workshop. everything was organized very well. Chef Emanuele showed us the techniques of how to make 3 kinds of pasta, to my surprise, the techniques couldn't be easier enough. its almost impossible to mess it up and finally the food was probably the one of the best food we had in Rome, we are very proud of ourselves. I highly recommend this class for everyone. 🙂

My partner and I absolutely loved this experience! It’s was our first time making pasta and Emanuele was so engaging and patient with teaching us the techniques to make ravioli, tortellini, and fettuccine. We highly recommend this experience to all. It was definitely one of the best highlights of our Roma trip!

Highly recommend! Great food and great company. Emanuele set the vibes with great music and wine. He also accommodates for those who have allergies. I had gluten free pasta and it was the best gluten free pasta I’ve ever had. If you have the time, you should visit Emanuele.

Let me first by stating I have literally travelled the world and I come to Italy very often …. I have tried many experiences around the world and this class was truly world class and well thought out from the very beginning when you arrive by a warm welcome from Chef Emanuel … the whole night flowed so well … it was well organized and truly lots of fun ….. I grew up with family from Italy making home made pasta and yet I still learned a few new ideas and tricks I will now use in making my own fresh pasta. Everything here is thought out for you including even great music when you are working on your pasta to get you motivated ….. This is a must for anyone wanting to learn pasta making and he even teaches you how to make a beautifully delicious yet simple red sauce you will use regularly…….

This pasta class is truly amazing. Emmanuele is an amazing teacher. He lives for pasta. He explains everything you need to know and let you be part. It was such a lovely time. I highly recommend the class to everybody.

Didn’t really know what to expect but this is experience was awesome! I love cooking and my husband who isn’t the biggest fan even enjoyed it. Emanuel was fun and walked around a lot to make sure everyone was doing okay. Keep in mind, you make your own food so you’re not eating right away! We had two bottles of wine with our “classmates” dinner was as enjoyable of an experience. Finally, Emanuele was really kind. He gave recommendations and made sure we all had our commute back sorted out. I spent a lot of time finding the right cooking class and am so happy I found this!

Emanuele was a wonderful host and his love for all things pasta and food was abundantly clear from beginning to end. This was one of our favorite parts of our trip! As a bonus, the meal was as delicious as the experience!

A great workshop. You learn how to make pasta and then dine on your own.
Emanuel is very friendly and explains everything very clearly and actively.
A great family plan in Rome.

We had an exceptional time with the family. Captivating and playful from start to finish, all doused with a great red wine.
We are now ready to make our pasta!
Thanks to Emanuele

Emanuele was the perfect teacher, cooking with music was super fun, the group was only 7 people, all very nice and friendly. We had a lot of fun, laugh and will definitely cook our own pasta from now on :) we also had the pasta, some wine and cheese and an amazing dessert. A unique experience!

The workshop was fun and awesome! Emanuele was a very friendly, personable and enthusiastic chief. His passion for making pasta was inspiring and authentic. My husband and I enjoyed his stories and beautiful studio! Most of all, the taste of the pasta at the end was the BEST part of the experience! It was sooooo goooddddd!! I would highly recommend to everyone.
This was a great way to learn the differences in pasta production that affects quality. Very fun class, wonderful host, easy for beginners and great setting. Would definitely recommend.

This cooking class was excellent. It was a small and intimate group, and Emanuele took time to make sure each individual understood the steps for pasta making. The atmosphere was great, and Emanuele has an amazing connection with his guests. You can truly see his passion for what he does. He even took time after the class to assist us in ordering a cab to get back to the city center. We look forward to returning to Rome and taking other classes from him soon!

One of my top highlights from our visit to Italy! The class was authentic, well organized, informative and fun! Also not too easy or difficult. We can’t wait to try Chef Emanuele’s home recipes
for our friends and family! Thank you for an unforgettable evening!

Wonderful and unique experience. Emmanuele is not only passionate about pasta but caring greatly that his participants actually learn and understand everything. Small group, relaxed and fun atmosphere. Only to recommend when in Rome.
Great experience, Emanuele is a really nice person, he puts you at ease, you feel he likes what he does and he does it well. The meal was great, a real pleasure.

This was by far the most amazing cooking class that my wife and I have ever attended, and we’ve been to dozens! Emanuele was so engaging, friendly and attentive while sharing his skills and techniques of making the most delicious pasta we have ever tasted. Everyone in our class got along great, with lively conversation and fun interaction. I would rate this class six stars if that were possible!! Best best best time in Rome!!! Love making pasta. Emanuel went above & beyond with this class. I learn a bunch about pasta. Highly recommend it if you are in town 💕
We had a wonderful time at Emanuele. The pasta was so good, and we made it ourself! Emanuele can talk very enthousiastic about cooking, it was so much fun!

Emanuele provided an amazing pasta making experience. Learned to create various pasta types and best practices. The atmosphere was great and Emanuele’s fun personality made it more enjoyable. This is a must do experience!
Amazing experience, loved learning the art of pasta as well as tasting! Beautiful time with Emmanuele, go there without so much as a second thought and enjoy!

This was a top highlight of our two week trip! A cozy setting to learn how to make pasta by hand was a dream!

Everything from the communication, to the ambiance, details of the menu, instructions and evening were so much fun. Emanuele and his assistant were kind, funny, helpful and engaging the whole evening. We felt like we were getting a 1 of a kind experience.

We had a delicious dinner that we prepared and overall it was such a fun evening. We hope to take another class with him in the future!!

A wonder time learning how to make some delicious pasta dishes. Emanuele was a great instructor, teaching is in what goes into making high level pasta. I would highly recommend this experience.

excellent experience, really entertaining and please evening of food and (plenty) of wine. highly recommend this to anyone interested in food, especially making their own pasta.

Highly recommend!

If you want to have dinner in Rome but also learn by doing yourself, you should definitely book this experience.

Such a fun experience! My friend and I took the class with 6 others and not only did we learn so much about making pasta, we got to meet other travelers and share a meal together. 10/10 would recommend!
I picked this experience to surprise my husband for our honeymoon and we loved it! So fun meeting new people and learning how to make pasta. We can’t wait to try these recipes at home!
Amazing experience. Emanuele creates a fantastic atmosphere between the group and adopts a very personal approach to teaching his methods. And yeah, the food is unbelievable.

Wow!! Emanuele gave us an experience we won’t forget. The entire vibe was friendly and fun. There was a lot of thought put into the structure of the night, and the food was AMAZING. Grazie Emanuele! Bravo!

Great experience. Emanuele was a tremendous host. I learned more than I thought i would about making pasta and the secrets to creating such a delicious meal. I would recommend this to anyone in Rome looking for fun night with friends or a loved one.

Emanuele provided a wonderful pasta making experience! He is fun and energetic and we are very glad we added this to our trip. Don’t hesitate to book if you’re looking to learn to make authentic Italian food!

The experience with Emanuele has been incredible! The place is beautiful, and everything was perfectly arranged for the comfort and safety of all attendees. This was my first Airbnb experience and it far exceeded my expectations. Emmanuele was quick to respond and effortless with communication and making us feel comfortable. This was seriously the best night we had in Rome, we made our own pasta, had some great laughs, shared stories, made new friends, and drank delicious wine. I would do this again! Don’t wait to book! Go cook with emmanuele!

Emanuele is a wonderful host and chef. I am not someone who feels comfortable in unknown environments easily, but I felt very at home making pasta with him and the other guests at his class. Emanuele is a wonderful chef and host! Had so much fun making pasta from scratch with the freshest ingredients, all under the guidance of a master chef.

Amazing experience! Emanuele know his craft and shares it with generosity and total clarity. We not only learned how to make italian pasta, but had a very pleasant evening. Grazie!

Emanuele's shop is located in a very charming but sometimes overlooked neighborhood called San Lorenzo. I've lived in Rome for 10 months and it wasn't until my family came to visit and wanted to take a cooking class that I learned how to make fresh egg pasta. Emanuele grew up in his parents' pastificio (pasta shop) from a young age, so if you're looking to learn from a professional look no further. He opened his own pastificio and it was recognized by Gambero Rosso (a prestigious food & wine magazine in Italy) as one of the best pasta shops in Rome. You can tell how passionate he is about making great pasta and teaching others how to make great pasta in the way he presents his class and interacts with his guests. Whether you're a seasoned cook or a new to the kitchen, Emanuele has structured the class in a way that will make it successful for any level. Making pasta from scratch might seem intimidating, but after spending just a few hours with Emanuele learning the best tips and tricks I've made the same fresh pasta in my own home. Emanuele, his pastificio, and his staff are so charming and welcoming. This experience is guaranteed to be a highlight on your trip to Rome.

This was an amazing experience. Everything from the location to the instruction to the final result was perfect. My wife and I had such a great experience with Emanuele and his staff and are eager to recommend this experience to all our Rome-bound friends! Of all the “experiences” we’ve had on our trip, this is perhaps the most memorable.

A very fun evening filled with delicious food, red wine, and pasta making knowledge. Enjoyed the group of students in the class as well. I feel confident I can now make pasta at home. A great experience! Would highly recommend.
Fantastic experience! What a pleasure to learn the art of pasta making from someone so passionate about what he does and with a lovely team around him. Highly highly recommend!

Emanuele is extremely good at what she does, with the simplicity of genres she taught us techniques that greatly contributed to our professional training. Such an experience! Friendly and wonderful staff, so much to learn, very nice equipment and a great setting. I will always remember this, and the learning is so valuable as well. Highly recommend.

A truly terrific experience. A really cute and cozy space that felt open and welcoming. Emanuele is the perfect host; open, energetic, passionate, and genuine. It felt perfectly paced with just enough instruction paired with plenty of time to get your hands dirty. The evening ends with new friends, fresh pasta, and plenty of wine. What more could you want?

This class is absolutely the highlight of my trip! I didn't know that making pasta could be that easy, but still keeping the authentic and classic basic of making fresh pasta. And Emanuele ensure everyone in the intimate group feel welcomed.. Great experience!

For our first time to Italy, this was a spectacular activity! Food is my love languages and I feel the best way to get to know other cultures is through their food history. I left feeling confident in my pasta making skills. I will be making authentic Italian pasta for family and friends using the family recipes Emanuele provided. Delicious food and great company!! Would definitely take another class from him 😍

My mum and I had a great evening at Emanuele. We learned a lot about how we create perfect pasta and later we ate all the delicious food and drink good red wine at the big cozy tabel. Awesome last dinner in Roma :-)

Emanuele’s class was truly an amazing experience! I actually had another class scheduled and cancelled and some how ended up purchasing this class. I’m sooooo glad that I did! We’ve never taking a cooking class and my significant other and I really enjoyed it! I loved the interaction and the intimacy! It was fun, romantic and entertaining! I can’t wait to show off my skills. Thank you Emanuele! Continue to teach your talents and passion!
In a very nice and warm setting, Emanuele and her team are here to welcome you. Passionate about sharing his love for real Italian food. Real good fresh pasta! Definitely recommend!

This experience was one of the things we loved most about our trip! We were looking forward to it and it was cooler than we expected! The pasta we prepared with Emanuele's guidance and all you've taught us was the best pasta we've ever had! It was a lot of fun cooking and then dinner with a wonderful wine and the best limoncello we've ever had! Thank you for an amazing experience, Emanuele!

The absolute highlight of our trip to Rome. Emanuele and his helpers made this experience so unique and memorable. The venue was clean, cosy and well-equipped. Completely exceeded our expectations. We can’t wait to put what we learnt into practice at home!

My friend and I had so many options for Airbnb experiences in Rome, but her love for noods led us to a few highly-rated cooking class options. We chose Emanuele’s class based on his solid 5-star review streak. As the class approached, we knew we were going to be a bit late due to our poor planning (remember: there’s no Uber in Roma!) so I, embarrassed, knowing we’d potentially be holding up the rest of the group, shot off a note to Emanuele to give him a heads up. He responded with levity and understanding, and the moment we arrived, we were immediately welcomed and brought up to speed by his fantastic assistant and dove straight into the class. (It’s nice not to feel like you’ve been “put on time out” during your holiday!) The lesson was interactive, fun, and instructional—with practical tips given with the assumption that we’d be trying this at home. The ambiance was relaxed and intimate (small group!) and we were given the chance at the end to kick back over a communally-shared, candle lit meal, enjoying the dishes we’d just individually put so much care into, shoulder-to-shoulder in the kitchen. It felt like a dinner among friends from home, although we’d all only just met, and each of us called someplace different “home.” We left Emanuele’s feeling confident to approach this cuisine in our own kitchen and we won’t soon forget the experience. It was impossible not to embrace Emanuele’s passion for pasta... but his love of people is truly the heartbeat of his operation. He really is the best pasta coach around! So if there’s a special place in your heart (and tummy) for pasta... or if you simply need a real reminder of of what passion and purpose look like, book this experience now. Your soul and stomach will say grazie mille.
What an incredible experience! Definitely recommend this to anyone in Rome! Emanuele and his team made us feel very welcome, and we learnt so much! Loved it!

Very positive atmosphere, helps connect and feel like home in this small group. Pasta super delicious and whole class made it this way under Emmanuelle's direction. Truly something to remember from Rome!
I'm just sitting here at the end of the class... and I can only say: do it! Book this class ! It's going to be a beautiful evening ❤️ i Love it

Big WOW! Emanuele’s pasta class was the highlight of our trip! This guy is so full of charisma and passion, that you will leave this experience with a full belly AND a wealth of knowledge/inspiration. I cannot sing enough praise for how genuine the entire experience was for us - why make pasta with nanna when you can do it with a world-class chef?? 🙌

The experience was incredible! We enjoyed every single minute of being there.
Emanuele is a real expert in pasta making plus he is a very nice, friendly and funny person. He was able to make 14 strangers friends by the end of the meeting. We learnt how to make pasta and had a lot of fun together.
When in Rome, don’t miss this experience!

When in Rome.... the Pasta Lab experience with Emanuele is a must! It can take me a lot of research to find the right experiences for my family (husband and 2 sons, 22yo, 19yo) to do on a holiday and we all agreed that this experience is on top of the list! Emanuele and his team made all of us feel very welcome... we had a group of 12 (including us) and we all had a fabulous evening with the added bonus of learning a new skill! My son arrived back in London and cooked freshly made fettuccine for his girlfriend dinner! No excuses for any of us not to as Emanuele was a fantastic teacher!

This was the perfect experience for our first trip to Rome. Emanuele was clearly an expert in his craft and the night was very fun. I was in a group of about 10 people from around the world. Overall, I definitely recommend.

Pasta class with Emanuele was everything I hoped it would be and more - very well run and efficiently structured to give you a good understanding of pasta making. Very hands on. Great explanations. Lovely setting. Fantastic dinner with other class members. Focus on quality. I looked at so many pasta making classes and in the end was extremely happy with my choice.

This was a 4 star very fun and professional, pasta course like experience!. Plus, gnocchi bonus lesson since it was Thursday! Situated near Termini Station it was very easy to find. An Inviting Street Level space which had hidden restaurant kitchen, the lesson prep space and big dining area for the group (10) to enjoy their creations! It was an international group ranging in ages and everyone was enthusiastic. Emanuele was a great teacher, had a wonderful energy and made the class personal and super fun! I would definitely recommend if you want a fun and yummy lesson!
The highlight of my trip to Rome! If nothing else, take this pasta class. Emanuele is a delight and we left with new friends and fantastic recipes for the future. Grazie Mille!
We absolutely loved our pasta class with Emanuele! He made us feel very welcome and is a great teacher! We can't wait to use our new skills back home in Australia :) from Rachel and Sarah

Emanuele’s class was very immersive, personal, professional, friendly and entertaining.

My wife and I had our expectations far exceeded and it was an experience that we will remember.

Emanuele had a great understanding of his craft and was able to articulate instruction well for all participants who were from different parts of the world. He made everyone feel welcome.

We highly recommend his class!

If you visit Rome, love Pasta and are interested in learning about traditional Italian cooking- you absolutely MUST try Emanuele’s class. It was truly one of the highlights of our honeymoon. Not only did we have an amazing and immersive experience, we got to meet some really great people and walked away with (pasta making) skills and memories that we will have for life. Emanuele was so generous with his knowledge, time and also hospitality, treating us to a delicious dinner at the end of the class. A truly special, unique and quintessentially Roman experience. Thank you Emanuele!

Emanuele is an absolute gem of a person and host. His knowledge and expertise is obvious as soon as he starts talking. On top of all that, he takes the time to get to know everyone in the class and truly make you feel special.

This class is 100% worth it.

Emanuele and his team were amazing! Emanuele taught us how to make pasta very clearly and concisely. The steps and instructions were very easy to follow. Emanuele’s background in pasta and his love for teaching clearly shines through.

Also, all of our pasta was delicious! He teaches you how to make a spectacular filling for ravioli that we ate all the leftover of while making our pastas. Everything was perfect!

I am so glad my friend and I did this! It was such a unique experience, and the staff was so nice and helpful. I learned so much, and feel that I can now make pasta on my own at home! Emanuele puts a lot of thought into the class to make it enjoyable. Making the pasta was fun, and eating it was too! Would definitely recommend!
This was truly a highlight of our trip. Emanuele is a master of pasta with such a great teaching style that he made it both fun and informative. I would highly recommend this class!

We highly recommend Emanuele and Pastifico Faini. The three hour class absolutely flew, the recipes and techniques he taught were not only simple but incredibly delicious and we're confident we'd actually be able to replicate them at home which is what we wanted out of this experience! Grazie mille Emanuele e Francesca!
Awesome experience - he replied right away and I was able to attend he experience the same day I messaged him! Food was so tasty, and they accommodated my gluten allergy. 10/10

We are a family of five with 3 teenage boys, the whole experience was fantastic with all members of the family rating this as a highlight of our trip to Rome. Definitely an experience that should not be missed

One thing for sure: Go home and make pasta! Emanuele conveys passion and expertise that make the course unique. Pleasant how the program is structured; a great satisfaction for the palate and the eyes to eat what was prepared with their own hands that until shortly before, perhaps typing a keypad in the office... Highly recommended experience to all

One of the most fun evenings my friends and I had while visiting Rome! Emanuele is not only incredibly knowledgable about pasta making, but also extremely encouraging to those of us who were making pasta for the first time. And let me tell you, you are going to be so proud of yourself because that pasta you're going to make is going to be GOOD! My mouth is watering just thinking about it.
This was an unforgettable experience! Emanuele and his team are professionals and made everyone feel welcome. My friend’s and I are taking what we learned with us forever!

The experience was very interactive and engaging, and Emanuele was an excellent host getting to know everyone there and sharing his own background and passion for his work.

I would recommend this experience for anyone who loves pasta, or simply has a spare few hours in Rome and wants to do something social.

This was such a fun, upbeat experience. My husband and I really enjoyed learning from Emanuele's passion for making pasta. I enjoyed the small group atmosphere and felt like I could really talk to everyone involved. Emanuele was such a great teacher and I felt comfortable while trying something new. I really loved getting to sit together as a group, enjoying our pasta and conversations with everyone. I highly recommend Emanuele pasta making experience!

This class was AMAZING!!! I learned so much and feel that I can now go home and make home-made pasta with confidence and ease. Emanuele was very nice and did a great job explaining everything and gave personal attention to each class participant. We had such a fun night as a group, enjoying the pasta we made and chatting with Emanuele. Would definitely recommend you take this cooking class :)))

Such a great experience! I was hesitant taking the class as I’ve never done a cooking class before (and thought it was a lot of money to spend on one thing) but I am so happy I did. My boyfriend and I had the best time! I also have a gluten-intolerance, but Emanuele was very helpful (offered to provide a gluten-free buckwheat flour). I used a mix of this and the regular (gluten-filled but natural flour he uses) and I had no stomach issues at all, it was great! The pasta we made melted in your mouth and he made it so simple to follow along, taking time to work with each of us. All of us (10 people) got to bond over making the pasta and chat while we ate it. Emanuele had such a passion for it, and he gave the best advice/tips for cooking and where to explore in Rome. I would recommend this to anyone. Trust me, you can’t come to Rome and not try it!!

My boyfriend and I took Emanuele’s class the last day we were in Italy ... and it was by far, the BEST thing we did! Emanuele was an amazing teacher. The way he structured the class was easy, fun, and allowed us to connect to the other participants. I’d highly recommend taking Emanuele’s class!
Absolutely wonderful cooking class and dinner! The pasta making techniques are very interesting and super fun to learn about. I would highly recommend to anyone spending a few days in Rome!

Absolutely brilliant experience. I have never made pasta from scratch before, however, with the help and advice from Emanuele and his team, I will certainly be making my own pasta in the future. Benchmark is set for this experience, and if i am to visit Rome again I would certainly take part in this experience again.

Wow. What an amazing experience. We have never done anything like this before, so were unsure what to expect. From the second we arrived, Emanuele and his team made us feel extremely welcome. His knowledge, enthusiasm and friendliness made the experience incredible from start to finish. I never thought that I would be able to make pasta from scratch (let alone DELICIOUS pasta) but Emanuele made the whole experience so easy. I cannot recommend this enough. If you are in Rome, you HAVE TO DO THIS.

Such a fun night! There are other pasta classes out there but Emanuele and Francesca’s class is by far the best! They are kind, fun experts and the whole group (couples, family with teenagers, family with younger child) had a fabulous time. I actually feel confident that I can make delicious ravioli, tortellini, and fettuccine on my own! Grazie mille!

Our first pasta-making class, and the yardstick by which all future classes will be measured to! It was fun, informative, well-presented and easy to follow. Emanuele and Francesca helped us feel a little bit more Italian, and a lot more confident that we all can make pasta! The space was modern, cozy and well-equipped. The chefs worked seamlessly together and provided constant personal attention and assistance as we laboured. It was obvious that they’ve found their joy in this work! Best part was tasting our creations, and enjoying each others’ company. Highly, highly recommend this immersive activity!

Emanuele and his team were awesome instructors and hosts! My group and I thoroughly enjoyed this pasta making experience and we left feeling like a pro! Highly recommend this class to anyone who’s interested in learning to make fresh pasta. Book directly with Emanuele via his website or social media channels.

Great hands-on experience for old and young alike. Emanuele is a welcoming and engaging host. He and his sous chef Francesca are genuine, warm and very passionate about pasta making.

Highly recommended for anybody who loves to learn more about ( and eat!) pasta.

I would highly recommend this experience day. The host is lovely and very knowledgable about pasta. It was structured very well and explained very clearly step by step. It’s perfect for groups and couples and hosted in a comfortable and modern kitchen/space.
Very interesting and fun activity. Emanuele welcomes us warmly and is very attentive throughout the course. I would definitely recommend this activity!

This experience was amazing. Emanuele is warm and welcoming, and he has a great teaching style. I cannot wait to go home and find fresh ingredients and the appropriate flour to start making real pasta. Thanks so much!

We thoroughly enjoyed our pasta making class with Emanuele. He was clear in his instructions, so that we left feeling confident we could try this at home. The other guests were friendly, and it was a wonderful experience to sit down for dinner with new friends and eat the pasta we had just made while enjoying a nice wine.

A must do when you are in Rome. Emanuel and his staff are personable and friendly. The pasta that you make is delicious and his sauces are a perfect match.
Well done Emanuel.
Emanuele is a great teacher and host. His method for creating pasta and sauce is easy to follow and fun to work on. I had a great time!

Would highly recommend this experience to everyone. Emanuele and his team were fantastic - friendly, warm, welcoming, knowledgeable, helpful.. The compliments could go on forever! We had such a fun time interacting with the group and eating the pasta we made (with all the little adds on here and there like wine, cheese, dessert etc). We can’t wait to make our own pasta and sauces at home! Thank you for such a lovey experience!

This was by far the BEST experience on my Italy trip!! Emanuele made it fun, interactive, and easy for us to make pasta. The presentation and his instructions were very simple and easy for us to follow.

We met a fun group of people from Brazil, Australia, NY, and Singapore. We had a great family style dinner with our pasta and amazing wine!

I am so excited to have pasta parties with my friends once I'm back home. Thank you for this wonderful experience. We will back next time, ciao!!
This is a must do. My girlfriend and I had a great time and you can see how passionate and proud Emanuele is in his class! Had a great experience and would absolutely do again and recommend

Loved it.
From the start, the atmosphere felt relaxed and personable.
Learning about what type of flour to choose for the healthiest pasta to make was a valuable insight.
We even got to know the other participants on a more personable level.
To me, that says a lot about the host and his staff and how they made us feel welcomed.
The most touching moment was when the Host handed the Ravioli cutter to my son and bought out a plate of deserts with a Candle on top for his birthday. Very much appreciated

Thank you again for this
This was such a fun class to go to and learn about pasta making. They were very helpful and kind. Great experience highly recommend going!

Emanuele is a chef with lots of pasta making experience. He and his sou chef made the experience so much fun and easy. He provided all the ingredients and tools we needed. He demonstrated how to perform each technique and then he walked around providing assistance or feedback. The class had 12 people which made it very intimate and we got to know each other guest in addition to the chef and the sou chef. We made three different types of pastas (ravioli, tortellini and fettucini). At the end, the chef cooked the pasta and served it to us for dinner. Rather than serving each our own individual made one, he combined everyone's together so we got to taste others. I am sure it was easier this way. Additionally, the chef made a special pasta dish for us to taste so we had 4 pastas total. The chef was very generous with drinks at the end, i think he provided 6 or 7 bottles of wine plus a bottle of Limoncello. Overall, the class was very fun and i learned a lot. I would highly recommend. Oh lastly, he provided a copy of the recipes!

Couldn't recommend this experience enough. My partner and I absolutely loved the pasta making class. Emanuele was very informative and funny during the class. Such a great skill to learn from an expert! It was a great experice and one we won't ever forget!

An unbelievable class. Whether you have a basic knowledge of pasta making or none at all, this is an amazing hands on experience. Emanuele is a true expert and his passion comes out in his teaching. 12/10, will be recommending to all of my friends.

Our experience with Emanuele was the best we had in Italy. This wasn't only a pasta making class but a night we got together and make friends and enjoyed the food we all contributed to. Emanuele was a breath of fresh air and so kind. There was never a question that bothered him and he was there to make sure we left feeling like we make the pasta at home and easily. Can't speak highly enough of him!

I absolutely loved this class! My girlfriend and I were debating whether we wanted to do it or not because it was our last day in Rome, but we are so glad that we did it! The class was amazing and super easy to follow along with. Emanuele explained everything very clearly and he added his own personal stories that made the class even more enjoyable. We met some wonderful people from all around world and we got to really connect with them while eating the pasta that we made. Overall an amazing experience!

This review is simple: If you like pasta, you would be making a big mistake to visit Rome and not book a class with Emanuele. It’s a small group, it is paced very well, and you get a meal at the end.
You will love it.

The experience we had with Emanuele was just great. So genuine, unique, people oriented. And it taught us things which we will now easily repeat at home. I would suggest this experience to anybody who would like to do something special and different. Emanuele is a great host and his entire staff made us feel welcome and well taken care of. Absolutely recommended!!!

The experience was truly one of a kind. Emanuele was very very friendly and an obvious expert and we loved every second of it. We believe we are able to reproduce the pasta we've made. The only downside is that we'll never have pasta as good as we had today. 11/10.

This was hands-down a fantastic experience! We were hot and tired coming to this activity and I was worried I wouldn't be able to enjoy it with hurting feet and being so tired. But from the start, it was amazing and Emanuele was such a great and enthusiastic teacher that I forgot all my pain and woke up! It was fun and interesting. I love how he and his assistants give such clear explanations and stopped periodically so we could try - and taste! The ending meal was fun and we were able to meet many other travelers from other places and who ere at different states of their vacations. Superb! Don't miss it!

Emanuele was fantastic. He did a great job connecting with everyone, was very knowledgeable and helped us understand the culture. The food turned out great and we had plenty of wine! Totally worth it.

I am so happy I chose Emanuele’s Pasta making class over all the others. I felt welcomed and included in the learning experience. The way Emanuele teaches the class, everyone on the learning spectrum will walk away knowing how to make fresh pasta. Also, Francesca was so sweet and helpful, and she makes a delicious desert. I felt like I was cooking and eating a meal with family. I would highly recommend partaking in this experience.
Thank you Emanuele for sharing your passion. Thank you Francesca for your joy and helpfulness.

Grazie di cuore!

I had a great time with Emanuele and his team. Emanuele is very enigmatic and entertaining to watch. They are very supportive and cater to any level of experience and skill. Emanuele went into depth about the different quality of pastas and explained some traditional sauce recipes to us. We were provided with an aperitif of prosecco, wine with our dinner (the pasta we made) and homemade limoncello for digestif with dessert. As you can imagine we all left quite tipsy! Most importantly I feel confident enough to try making pasta again at home which is what I really wanted, so thank you.

A complete, successful evening with a lot of joie de vivre. You learn how easy it is to make a REALLY GOOD pasta yourself. This was by far the best experience of our trip to Rome this year. It was really fun: clear recommendation!

I would highly recommend anyone visiting Rome sign up for this experience. It was a great reprieve from the touristy areas of Rome and allowed you to experience the wonderful culinary side of Rome. A must do!

Emanuele was an absolutely wonderful host! He did a great job teaching the group how to make pasta. It felt very authentic and unique. The setting was great! And the group dinner had a really friendly and comfortable atmosphere - a great opportunity to get to know people from around the globe! We were so excited to come home and make pasta on our own!

We had a great time learning about pasta, making it and then eating it all. The dinner afterwards with the 12 participants was sociable and fun with pasta, dessert and plenty of wine. Can highly recommend this!

This is the perfect class. I spent so much time researching classes and I am so glad I found this. Emanuele is so knowledgeable, talented, and genuinely friendly. We made the most delicious pasta, drank wine and limoncello, and shared a wonderful time. The class felt small and personal and by the end everyone was friends and enjoying each other’s company. I can not recommend this experience enough and I wish Emanuele the best! Bon Appetito!!

A wonderful experience, definitely a great introduction to hand made pasta techniques. The experience was complemented with some delicious wine and Emanuele's lovely personality. Easy for even those who are beginners to cooking. Emanuele and his team took a genuine interest in teaching each of us at the class and graciously answered any questions we had. We left the event with a great appreciation for fresh pasta.
While we spent 10days in Rome, this experience will be my favorite. They welcomed our children (5 &7) warmly and made them feel part of the experience.

We are a family of four looking for something creative and unique to do. Everywhere we looked no one would take children. I knew my children, who love to cook and know basic-moderate techniques for their age, would do fantastic in a cooking class, so I was excited to find someone who was open to my children.
Emanuel and his assistant, Francesa, were so wonderful in involving my children and truly teaching them. They made eye contact and spoke to them with respect and kindness. They took the time to help them individually which in turn allowed me to also learn! This experience was so unique and the group dynamic with the rest of the class beautifully unfolded as we all enjoyed the fruit of our labor, our pasta and the provided wine. The conversation flowed as the food was brought out, perfectly timed. I would recommend this to anyone visiting Rome! A very professional, yet intimate setting that allowed human interaction to unfold in a very happy way. Such a memorable night and one of the best experiences we had in our six weeks traveling.
Great way to experience Italian Culture and cuisine....guests young and old had as much fun as the hosts and his assistant chef. !!

The whole experience was fantastic. The shop was clean, modern and very professional. All the staff were friendly, patient, supportive and very professional. We had an intimate group of students who all had a laugh while making and eating the food. I walked away excited to take home the pasta skills I learned.

Emanuel and his staff were very passionate about pasta and went into detail as to what makes a top quality product and showed us exactly what to do.

I researched several pasta making classes on several sites before choosing this one. This was a unique chance to learn from one of the top 10 pasta makers in Rome. Amazingly, Emanuele has a gift for teaching even non-experienced cooks. Even experienced foodies will learn a lot.

I cannot recommend this experience enough. I have spent 3 weeks in Italy and this was easily the most memorable experience of my trip. So so good. Loved everything about it. Emanuele and his staff are brilliant. Do yourself a favour and get involved.

We had such a great time! Emanuele was extremely engaging and welcoming and was very easy to learn from. The pasta was amazing, and Emanuele did a great job of breaking down different techniques and showing us how to make different kinds of pasta. It was a blast!
He was super passionate about his work, welcoming to all the guests and knew what he was talking about. Definitely recommend! We were fed quite well too :)

If you’re debating between this and another popular pasta-making class, do this one!!! You are learning the best of the best techniques from an expert! The atmosphere is cozy but not cramped, and professional but not intimidating. As someone who can be a little introverted in new situations, I was worried about doing a group class, but Emanuele’s warm demeanor made everyone feel at ease and we got to know people from Canada, Australia, Romania, and the US! His assistant Francesca is just as lovely, and between the two of them, I felt like we had just enough one-on-one attention to make sure we were doing things right without feeling like someone was breathing down our necks! :) At the end of the class, we ate some of the best pasta I’ve ever had and drank Prosecco, red wine, and limoncello. If that doesn’t sound like the best night in Rome, I’m not sure what does!

Absolutely a 5-star experience! Emanuele is an expert but he makes it easy enough for you to understand and take your new “skills” home with you. He was the kindest host and our favorite part of our visit to Rome!! Even if you don’t think you need to take a pasta class, you do- with Emanuele! Highly, highly recommend it!

Emanuele's Pasta cooking class was a wonderful experience and great fun! Since I'm travelling on my own it was a good way to get in contact with other people. Everything was well structured and prepared, Emanuele and his assistant Francesca helped and gave good advice, too. Francesca also prepared a wonderful desert. :-)
I think I will be able to prepare good Pasta back home thanks to this cooking class!
Great time shared with Emanuele! We leave Rome with the "hand made" pasta recipe in our suitcase! The class ends with a pleasant moment: aperitif, dessert, limoncello 😊
My best air bnb experience by far! So fun cooking, learning how to make pasta for my family and to meet fellow travelers! Emanuelle was a dream! Highly recommend!
Emanuele shared many great insights into Italian cooking and was very knowledgeable in the history of the cooking techniques as well. Overall a worthwhile experience to do while in Rome.

Great experience!! I would recommend this to any friends or family that visit Rome! Emanuele and his assistants were so nice and knowledgeable. I was a little late and they caught me right up to speed on making the pasta with the rest of the group. Couldn’t have been better!!

Emanuele and Francesca were very inviting and this experience is one of a kind! We learned to make pasta the old fashioned way which made the consistency tougher and a lot tastier. Also the class fostered a family environment with other people during the experience and I loved chatting with other tourists during the experience. This is a great way to experience Rome.

Had a really fun an enjoyable experience. My partner and I had a lot of fun from start to finish delicious dinner and overall fun experience. Highly recommend this as a fun evening out. Fun group and extremely knowledgeable host!

We were a group of friends who visited Rome before, and I was looking for a cultural experience more than a tour. This was the perfect plan, everybody enjoyed it and left happy. Emmanuelle was amazing, he was so kind and patient. We recommend this experience to everybody !

This was an absolutely amazing experience! I have lived in Rome for 4 years now and have taken several cooking classes but Emanuele’s class was top notch! It was interactive, authentic, fun and we ended up learning A LOT! My husband and I went with 2 friends who were in town visiting us and we left with full belly’s and full hearts after an amazing night! Thank Emanuele - we can’t wait to come back again!
Really enjoyed the class. Emiliano and Francesca were super attentive and kind during the class. I definitely learned techniques that I can use at home!

10/10. Great fun- met lots of fun other travellers. Making the pasta.was wonderful--- expert attention to details and Emanuele kept everyone on pace. Dinner afterwards was lovely- with plenty wine and a lovely dolce. Perfect evening!

Super fun learning how to make Ravioli, Tortellini, Gnocchi (because it was Thursday), and Fettucine, all completely by hand. It was fun and much easier than I would have thought, and the Ravioli in bechamel sauce at dinner was one of the best pastas we have had in Italy! Looking forward to trying at home. Also Emanuele is a passionate and knowledgeable host. Highly recommended!

A great evening and a fantastic meal! We had fun learning and making friends and the pasta we shared at the end of the evening may well have been the best meal we have had here in Italy! Emmanuele is clearly a very knowledgeable chef and he and his staff were very welcoming and accommodating. Highly recommend this class.

Such a wonderful class, highly recommend this!! You are able to had insight to pasta making and you are taught in a way that you will be able to take the skills with you home! We were so happy we took this pasta class!

I’ve taken many cooking classes and Emanuel did not disappoint. He explained all steps and answered all of our questions. Each of us felt a sense of accomplishment. The food turned out wonderful and I will definitely be making the recipes at home. Definitely a professional establishment. Bravo!
This is the place to go if you want to learn how to cook pasta. A real passionate chef! Looking forward to cook pasta at home now :)

We had 6 people in our group. Everyone enjoyed the experience. Emanuele was clear in his demonstration, and shared with us his insight on various technique.
