The first thing to know is that this place has been named one of the top ten best pasta places in Rome. IN ROME. So, safe to say he is in expert, as in really. Nothing more needs said, it was amazing. Book it, go, have fun, make more pasta!

The pasta lab experience was great for our last night in Rome. My friend and I had a wonderful time learning how to hand make pasta and talking with the other participants. Emmanuale was incredibly kind and we had a fun time with him.

Wow, what a fantastic experience it was taking this class with Emanuele! I only spent two days in Rome and this was at the top of my highlights. We spent the tome getting to know each other in the beginning and him telling me about his passion for cooking and the recipes coming from generations of his family. Once we got cooking you can tell he really loved the art of making authentic and fresh pasta. We focused on techniques and the quality of what we were making. Fortunately I was extremely lucky and was the only one signed up for the afternoon class and had a 1:1 experience. We made ravioli, tortellini, fettuccine and my personal favorite gnocchi. I would highly recommend spending the time while you’re in Rome learning and enjoying some of the best pasta you’ll ever have!

Do not miss this experience when in Rome. The host, the place, the professionalism and the passion that Emanuele has for his guests and for pasta can’t be compared. This is his passion and there is no doubt about it. The place is fantastic, spotless and genuine. The lab is brand new and and the location is spectacular. The ambiance, the music, the lighting, the setup were all perfect and way over my expectations. Feel special, make new friends in Italy and more importantly, do not miss this opportunity to learn how to make pasta like one else will ever teach you and then have a delicious meal.

I give this experience a definite 10/10 and was by far the highlight of my trip until now. I will book again when I am in Rome just to experience this once more and make new friends.
Amazing experience, Emanuele is one of the rare people who combine deep passion, professionalism and a great spirit of sharing in what he does. Absolutely recommended.

My experience with Emanuele and Pastaficio Faini was absolutely incredible. Emanuele is easily an expert in the history and making of fresh and dry pasta. He doesn't just show you how to make pasta, there are tons of places in Rome doing that. He teaches you about the history of the specific grain, traditional preparation methods, delves into his recipes and traditions of generations of his family. He makes the experience not just about pasta, but about food, family, tradition, love, and fun. I met people from all over the world in Emanuele's class, and every single one of us created amazing, delicious pasta and had a great time enjoying it with each other. I am also a Chef in the states and Emanuele has gone above and beyond to give me some further information and "training".

I cannot recommend this class enough and I cannot recommend a better person to be training such a class.

Exceptional experience! We made delicious pasta with a true expert and chatted with people from around the world. The food was delicious! The sauces the chefs made, wine paired, and dessert served were all so great. Would definitely do this again, worth every penny.

The experience was amazing and so was Emanuele! A unique experience situated in a small cozy restaurant. I booked this experience for my mother & grandmother as a surprise during our visit to Rome, and they(along with myself) absolutely loved it! Emanuele took his time to make sure that we actually understood the process and were able to do it ourselves. The food came out wonderfully, and we even received a complimentary chefs hat at the end that Emanuele so kindly signed for everyone. HIGHLY recommend!

Great experience in the pasta Lab of Emmanuele! The atmosphere was relaxed and enjoyable. Emmanuele was super friendly. We learnt a lot about pasta in general and how to make them. We made raviolis and pasta from our own, how to make the fillings, and how to cook a great sauce. Everything is really well explained by this pasta lover !
Greatly recommended if you are in Roma !
Emanuele was great. I had an amazing time and the food was delicious. This has been the highlight of my trip so far. I can’t wait to home and try my recipes.

This was a true Rome experience!
I was walking in Rome not sure what to do with my afternoon so I decided to check on AirB&B experiences to see if there was anything last minute I could find. I saw Emanuele's Pasta Class and decided to sign up.
I was amazed! He was welcoming, friendly, funny and extremely knowledgeable. His space is just gorgeous with a lovely atmosphere.
His teaching techniques are flawless and whether you are an experienced pasta maker or a first-timer, you will fit right in.
And the people I met that day was the icing on the cake.
By far the best experience I had in Rome was this class with Emanuele.

Such a fun experience! Emmanuelle was not only super knowledgeable but interactive and provided a fun environment. The cozy dinner atmosphere with people from different places in the world added to the great experience! Definitely recommend

Emanuele showed us how to make ravoli, gnocchi & linguine. After making these we got to eat the ravoli and gnocchi. He even served us complimentary prosecco and red wine at the table. We had a close knit group, so everyone got to know each other during the evening, making it even better to sit down with them all and share stories at the end. I couldn't recommend this experience enough! It was one of the highlights of our trip.

By far, this was the most fun we had on our holiday to Italy. The group dynamic was so much fun! We got to talk to the other travelers from all over the world and watch us all attempt to roll pasta out and make our filling for the ravioli and tortellini. Great fun! After we ‘mastered’ Italian pasta we sat down to eat the very pasta we made for lunch. Paired with some wine and lively conversation, we had an amazing time. Make sure you set part of a day aside to get away from the crowds and lines and relax with Emanuele, pasta and a great time.
the experience is great, we learned how to make pasta very easily. The kitchen is clean and each has its own countertop. Emanuele is lovely, and so is her team.
Outstanding night, everything went excellently well with Emanuele. He's easy to learn how to make pasta, and that's great . Then we tasted our concoctions, it was divine.

Fantastico. This was one of the best experiences I have done. It was the first time I have done a cooking class and Emanuele was brilliant. He is very friendly and knows everything there is to know about pasta. Would 100% recommend if visiting Rome. Can’t wait to make proper Italian pasta at home.
Awesome experience, the pasta lab is fantastic, and Emanuele is an awesome professor! We got delicious pasta at the end, and the recipes as well, which I will surely try at home soon!
What an incredible experience. Emanuele is a awesome chef and a great teacher. This was so much fun and I learnt so much, if you do nothing else in your life do this class.

My boyfriend and I took the class together, and both had a great time. My boyfriend is a good cook, but I can barely boil water and was nervous ahead of the class. However, Emanuele did an exceptional job at teaching both of us new techniques, and was very patient and helpful when we had difficulties. He makes it fun and interesting for everyone - from a seasoned home cook like my boyfriend to a noodle novice like me.

He teaches in a very professional environment, which is what we were looking for compared to classes taught out of apartments, and we learned more about pastaficios, including his, and how important making fresh pasta is.

We both feel that this class was a highlight of our trip to Rome and would highly recommend it for anyone who is interested in learning how to make pasta!

Brilliant evening making, and subsequently eating lovely pasta - pasta actually nicer than anything we subsequently ate during our visit in Rome. Also made it seem easy & looking forward to making our own at home. Emmanuel, and also his quietly helpful assistant, set up a lovely evening, full of great ambience, company, food, wine & limoncello!
A great course. We learnt so much and had so much fun (and the food was delicious too). He has a unique take on pasta so even if you have done a course before you will learn something new.

Emanuele is a very professional chef, learning us very clearly and patient, recommend for best places in Rome, after this experience - we felt like this is the best place in our trip. So thanks you Emanuele for those magic hours with you!!!
One of the highlights in Rome! Our host Emanuele is very knowledgeable and enthusiastic. The dinner we made was delicious and meaningful. Highly recommend it!
You can sense Emanuele's passion for pasta and he truly treats it as an art form where he wants his guests to be creative but also have fun.

Emanuele was amazing! This class was interactive and educational. Emanuele was super nice and patient, went around helping everyone. We made 2 different kinds of pasta & they shared prosecco and cheese during the class. When we sat down to eat our pasta, they served wine and gave us a delicious dessert afterward. Emanuele was just so great and helpful, I would highly recommend for anyone coming to Rome! I was in a small group environment in my class (there was 4 of us, my friend and I and another couple) because a group of 4 had cancelled, but it looks like he holds his class for up to 8 people. I think it would be a great experience if it was 4 or 8! Thanks again for everything :)

AMAZING!!! I had so much fun. I felt as if I had dinner with friends. This was such a cool experience, I will even do it again. I feel as though I got a piece of Italy within these few hours. A great addition to our trip.
A must if you are an italian food lover! The time goes so fast during the class that you cannot believe what goes on until you try your creation

Outstanding experience. Host Emanuele is very passionate on the topic. He is an excellent passionate teacher.

Class was correctly paced and fun all along.
What a fun class! Emanuele and his assistant were knowledgable and kind. I had an amazing time and can't wait to share my new pasta making skills with my friends when I get home.

Emanuele’s knowledge of pasta making really showed here in terms of how he conducted the class, giving us a lesson on its history, the different ingredients and methods to make different kinds of pasta. It was conversational and educational. He and his team made sure the environment wasn’t intimidating and ensured it was fun for everyone who participated.

Emanuele’s passion really comes through in this class and I highly recommend it for anyone wanting to learn and get some insight behind the pasta making process.

It was fun and we got to know the depths of the pasta. We made ravioli, fetoccine from the beginning, and at the end of the day we got a bottle of wine in our own (Website hidden by Airbnb) well as cooking skills, communication was seamless and we had the best time during our stay in Rome!

this experience is a must for anyone traveling to Rome and want to experience the Italian cuisine with an expert .
probably the best part of my trip to Rome.

The experience was great!! The explanation of to make pasta was simple so everyone could do it but the results were awesome, the food was delicious! It was also great that I told him it was my boyfriends birthday that day and he had a surprise for him when we had dessert! If you want to have a really good time with good food and wine this is your experience ☺️

We did this on our first day in Rome and we couldn’t be any happier. It was so fun, and we got to know everyone in the group. It was such a great experience. You can tell that Emanuele is passionate about what he does!

A really unique experience! Emanuele was a fantastic host and you notice immediately that he loves what he is doing. The workshop will teach you how to make original pasta in an easy and interesting manner so that you can use the methods you learn at home. The location is beautiful and the dinner afterward is as nice at it can get in Italy. The best thing about it: You actually will prepare this dinner! We booked this experience as a present for my fathers 60th birthday and it turned out to exceed our expectations. I just can recommend that experience to everybody who wants to learn to make pasta, loves Italian food or searches an experience which stands out.

Mille Grazie Emanuele!!

I booked this cooking class with a friend and we loved it. Emanuele is really very sweet and his assistant was also just sweet and accommodating. He did a really great job, so now we can also make Ravioli ourselves at home. Really a super nice experience.

Amazing experience with Emmanuel, I've had the best pasta ever, and it was made by me!
Will definitely do it again if I come back to italy! Gracie

Great family time with Emmanuele! Now we know how to make great pasta!! Everything was perfect, the dinner with guests was very nice...we recommend this experience without hesitation!
Thank you Emmanuele!🤗

We had an incredible time! The group was a good size because it was big enough that dinner was interesting and there was a lot to talk about but small enough that we got personalized experiences. We would absolutely go back, we really enjoyed it.
Such a fun experience! 100% recommend doing it.

There was no more than a dozen people in the dense courtyard, so I did it a bit.. The host (Emmanuel) took really good care of me. It was great to hold a party with the food I made at the end. I just want to enjoy it with you, but I have to get a lot of farming and sweat in English.
It was a good class to try. 80,000 won is not a waste!

It was a wonderful experience for both me and I study to be a future chef and my partner who loves pasta.
Emanuele is a great host, with a lot of knowledge and passion for what he does, he was always attentive to the 10 participants and we all felt wonderful. I would go back a thousand times!!!

I booked this class with a few girlfriends and it was so much fun.

Emanuele created a fun, relaxing environment. He was very passionate about cooking and an excellent teacher. We had some cheese and Prosecco while cooking and a nice sit down, candlelit meal of our hard work.

I’m excited to use the skills I learned and cook for my friends and family back at home. I would highly recommend this experience.
Super friendly and experienced host. The location is very clean and yet welcoming. Emmanuelle and his staff were so friendly and helpful. You really felt that they loved what they do.

So far the best experience we have had in Italy, one of the main highlights. Emanuele and his staff were fun, friendly, knowledgeable and efficient. It was great getting to know other travelers and we are so excited to go home and cook handmade pasta. The most delicious meal we have had in Italy. No comparison.

Emanuele was amazing and his assistant Francesca was awesome too! We loved his class, his passion for pasta made us love the class! Anyone that comes to Rome should take this class!! We feel confident in making our own pasta dishes without the gmo’s or preservatives! The wine and dessert were incredible!! We truly appreciate it him making us feel so comfortable!

It was a very useful class. It was good because there were many things I could cook for myself throughout the class. I think I'm lucky to have participated in this class. If you are interested in Italian cooking, I recommend you to take this class. :-)

The experience occurs in Emanuele's lab/kitchen/shop. It's designed for you to learn about pasta and at the same time, make your own pasta then eat your pasta with a specially prepared sauce. All ingredients are made from scratch which makes the food that much more precious and delicious.

My philosophy about food is that it's a labor of love, and you can truly sense the passion and love that Emanuele has for pasta making.

My family and I loved this experience and would do it again if we ever made it back to Rome!

Great teacher to learn how to make pasta and ravioli. He was very encouraging and gave you many explanations of how to make variations in the preparation of the food. The end result was delicious and I am confident I can make again!

My roommate and I went here already our first night in Rome. We booked through Airbnb a few days in advance and although it was Easter and holiday, there were just two spots left for us. The place was small but very cozy and good atmosphere. Emanuele taught us both how to make the pasta and sauce. We were able to take recipes (which he had printed out in advance) home - which were his family recipes.

The pasta we cooked and eat was the best pasta we had on our entire 5-day rumatur (and we did a lot of resarch before we went where we were going to eat!). We were a small group, making the experience more personalized and Emanuele gave each of us advice and tips during cooking. We were served bubbles, wine, and delicious cheese during the boiling process, and when we finished cooking, we all sat around a table eating the food we'd made ”as a big Italian family.“

I would definitely recommend this pasta class at Emanuele's. He also had two helpers, who helped with the cooking. They were very nice and helpful. Thanks for a great experience we won't forget!

This experience was one of the highlights on my trip to Rome. I got to learn a new skill and then enjoy the fruits of my labor first hand. It was such a joy to sit down with folks from all over the world and crack jokes while sharing a meal.

We had a great time making pasta with Emanuele and his team tonight. Professional, kind, generous and well educated in all there is to know about pasta! You will not regret taking this cooking course. We take a course during most vacations and this has been the best thus far.
Incredible experience! My family had a fabulous time learning how to make pastas and sauce with Emanuele. Then, after making it we got to eat it. Perfecto!

What an amazing class! We made a great variety of pastas. I really learned a lot from this class. Even better, we had such a fun time while doing it. I highly recommend this class. A must do for sure!

Great experience!! Highly recommend this class to any couples or friends traveling to Rome and looking to learn traditional ways of making pasta and gaining tips on recreating the meal at home. Emanuele is very friendly and was helpful even when I messed up in creating the pasta dough. He was fully present with each guest and it felt like a family-style dinner gathering. This trip was filled with many amazing things but this class was certainly the highlight of all my experiences!! Highly recommend!

Emanuele created a great experience where we learned to make pasta that we can do at home, and it was fun! We learned how to make different types of ravioli and fettuccine, and he even gave us his recipes for yummy sauces we can use in the future. It was a wonderful experience and in the end we got to eat what we made!

Book it now! I booked this as surprise for my husband and he loved it! Emmanuel was fun, knowledgeable and very inclusive. I was worried as my husband and I dont drink alcohol and our vegetarian but I sent Emmanuel a note about that before class and it was no problem! We learned how to make ravioli and fettucini and more! All were so easy that we feel confident that we can do it at home. I have already recommended the class to friends who are going to be in Rome. It's totally worth it. Took a taxi there but was able to walk back (lived near the trevi). All in all great experience:)

What can I say about this Airbnb experience beyond it was exceptional? Emanuele created a fun and safe environment for travelers like myself to connect with Italian culture through cuisine in his pasta shop. Every detail was thought of and his friendly staff didn't allow us to lift a finger throughout our cooking class outside of making pasta of course! After the course, we broke bread together as a class sitting around a table together, where Emanuele created such an inviting ambiance with candle lighting, pop music, and wine! But the detail which shows Emanuele's love for Italian cooking and his community is that a priest arrived at the end of the meal to pick up food from Emanuele's pasta shop to donate to those experiencing homelessness in Rome. It was incredibly touching to see and makes you want to support a business and a person like Emanuele, who has such heart.

I honestly don’t have words for how much I loved the experience. The evening was filled with great conversation, impressive cooking lessons, and fantastic food... not to mention, exceptional wine! Emanuele gives you the skills, knowledge, and confidence needed to replicate the evening on your own at your home! Truly an amazing time in Rome, would recommend to everyone!

Exciting experience, especially for firstcomers to Rome. This was indeed a highlight of my stay in the city. Emanuele is a great host. He and his assistant Francesca did all their best to make all participants feel interested and involved. I have known many nuances that one could recieve only through personal experience. The whole atmosphere of the evening was very inspiring and relaxed. Thank you, Emanuele!

We thoroughly enjoyed our pasta making experience with Emanuele. During the three hour course you learn to make two different types of pasta. After the cooking you sit down for a candle-lit dinner, enjoying the pasta the whole group has made, some wine and limoncello- delicious! No cooking knowledge or experience needed--fun for all ages and abilities. Thank you for making our trip to Rome special!

Excellent time for sharing, discovering, practicing and tasting. Highly recommended to confirm the discovery of the pure Italian tradition that is pasta. Emanuele and her team are very welcoming and attentive. Thank you for a lovely time.

Emanuele is a super host, he is passionate and insightful and made the whole experience an absolute pleasure. Not only was the pasta making such a fun experience but sharing it with everyone on the course over lovely drinks made it a night to remember.

We came to Rome on our honeymoon and decided to do a cooking class one night which happened to be my birthday as well. Emanuele was amazing ! He was engaging, entertaining, and knowledgeable. I would recommend this a 10/10 to anyone coming to Rome!!!

This pasta workshop is amazing. I did this with my daughter and we enjoyed it tremendously and of course learned how to make pastadeeg.
Emanuelle is an expert, whose enthusiasm is contagiously working on the whole group.
We made a delicious dish and consumed it together at a cozily set table.
Highly recommended!

Excellent course, Emanuele really brought the grouo together and kept a good dynamic the whole way through with his assistants. Learned a lot about pasta making and he stuck to simple tools which was great for wanting to replicate our lesson later. The food and wine after while we ate our creations was also excellent and we got a special little birthday celebrationas well, I felt very special.
This class was absolutely a highlight of our week in Rome and an opportunity to learn to make amazing pasta without fancy materials for the rest of your life.

Emanuele was a great host and teacher who made pasta making feel easy and fun. You got to make some different kinds of pasta and in the end you were served the pasta dinner together with the other group participants. The course was a great way to experience the Italian culinary

The pasta experience was a wonderful way to start off my trip to Italy. Emanuele made it easy for me to succeed when making the pastas, and provided assistance at all times if you weren't getting a concept or had a question. Emanuele and his team made the night very personable when they brought out cannoli for two of the guests birthdays. I'm so glad that I booked this experience, and I 100% recommend that you sign up for this class.

Emanuele's pasta class was so much fun! My husband purchased this as my birthday activity while we were in Rome and we had a blast. It was very interactive and we learned so much. Emanuele is clearly very passionate about his profession, and was very personable and let loose and had a great time with us. His staff were also very friendly and there to make the experience enjoyable and were available for hands-on help if we needed it. I wasn't aware before this how well-reviewed he is in many Italian cuisine publications! We really enjoyed sitting down at the end of the class to eat the pasta that we had made with the rest of the group and getting to know other travelers who were in the class with us. I'd definitely recommend this activity to anyone traveling through the area!
Very good experience spent with Emanuele, we had a good time of conviviality and left with some of the Italian know-how😊. The experience ends with a meal together. We really enjoyed our time.

It was a truly incredible experience! We were the youngest there but it was all inclusive and all age ranges were able to socialise and it was due to the environment Emanuele created! 10/10 would definitely recommend!

Thanks to Emanuele we have almost become "toquets" in the making of pasta. Our host is knowledgeable and knowledgeable with education and humor. We highly recommend this experience and look forward to hearing from our host regarding their book . Thank you to Francesca for her valuable help and new dessert. Amélie and Arthur

Mother and daughter (age 14) had a date-night-out to enjoy this experience. They've been making incredible home made pasta here in San Diego every since! They really enjoyed the evening, and loved the idea of learning a new life-long skill. Grazie!

The cooking class at Emanuele's is what I would definitely do again on a future visit to Rome. It was a great event, as nice as informative, professional and authentic.
Thank you Emanuele for showing us the Carboara.

Super recommended experience!! Emanuele and her kitchen are able to convey the passion for pasta.
The space is very pleasant, Emanuele's knowledge and practical explanation are excellent and the atmosphere is unique!
It brings you closer to Italian culture!
If you have a space during your visit to Rome, don't hesitate to meet Emanuele and his kitchen!
I would definitely repeat!

This was a amazing experience for my family and friends. From start to finish it was fantastic. Emanuele was so friendly, knowledgable, welcoming, funny and obviously talented! This made a wonderful dining experience truly memorable in Rome. As one of my sons said ‘best day ever, can we do it again tomorrow’! This is an experience not to be missed and truly a highlight of our trip so far!

This was such an amazing class! I cannot was emphasize enough how amazing and welcoming the host was. He was so knowledgeable about pasta and technique. It was overall an AMAZING experience. The set up of the classroom was perfect. Great food and even better company

My friends and I had such a lovely time learning how to make pasta with Emanuele! He is very passionate about what he does, and the style and organization of the class was terrific! Each of us had our own station where we got to practice what Emanuele showed us. We made ravioli, tortellini and fettuccine! Tasting what we made afterwards was such a delight, and everything was incredibly good. We even got to try some homemade limoncello, which blew others we'd had on the trip out of the water, it was so good! It was also such a fun way to meet and talk to other people traveling, our group was really fun! I would highly recommend this experience!

A wonderful night with Emanuele, a great experience for me and my family. Brilliant knowledge, a very cool venue and exciting and interesting enough even for 2 15 year old boys, who absolutely loved the event.
A great host, thank you Emanuele!
So good I am bringing my team here for a work event as well.

Our Pasta Making experience with Emanuele was truly wonderful. His expertise with the world of pasta is clear. His laboratory is a close and intimate setting for learning how to make pasta, and it forces everyone to chat and interact with one another. Probably the best way to spend our final night in Rome. We cannot recommend this experience with Emanuele enough.
This was a fantastic experience that my husband and I will be taking with us and using at home. It was a fabulous last night in Rome! Grazie, Emmanuele!

Emmanuel and Francesca are adorable and very attentive to us. You get a passion for food here. Even if you have no culinary knowledge, you'll have a great time. Thank you very much for a very pleasant time.
Alex and Stacy

This is by far one of the best experiences we have ever done. Emanuele has the knowledge of a professional, the enthusiasm of a young energetic child and the passion of a true Italian chef. We had so much fun making pasta. When we come back to Rome, we will be hitting Emanuele up again for his gnocchi making class.

What a great night! I was with my husband, sister and her husband and we had been traveling in Italy for 15 days by the time we went on this tour, it was the next to last night we were in Italy and we are so happy we were able to experience this pasta class. It was so much more! It was a fun evening of laughter, food and wine. What a great memory! Emanuele and his staff where fun, knowledgeable, creative, attentive and fun, did I mention fun? This is a great time for all, and to enjoy our meal after we created it ourselves was fantastic! Be sure to get there a bit early and go to the community park just down the street. There is a merry go round that is powered by a person on a bicycle, lots of families and kids and the best part...a place to get wine and beer and sit at some tables and feel very Italian! (Why don't we have parks with a little pub in the USA?)
You must do this, you will have a wonderful time, great memories and a passion for making your own pasta when you learn how easy it is (no equipment required)!

That's awesome! Experience to have. A unique moment, real good tips for restoring the recipe back home. All this ends with a warm tasting around a large table. Nice work! I would highly recommend it:)

A very friendly and warming host who is very knowledgable and passionate. Don't be deterred by how long the course takes there was never a moment that you looked at the clock or wanted it to be over. The whole experience was extremely engaging and will 100% be making homemade pasta again at home. Thank you.

We had so much fun on this experience! Emanuele was very experienced and helpful, his chefs were lovely too. The drinks were flowing and everyone was having a great time. The pasta we made was delicious and super easy to make, we definitely learnt skills we can take home. My only issue was that my pasta was put together on the same tray as the other people on our workspace before cooking and then shared between the group so you weren't necessarily eating all of your own creation, which was a shame as we all customised our own fillings, however this is minor and was probably just to save time. However, Emanuele let my boyfriend's pasta be cooked separately as he doesn't like cheese which was appreciated! I highly recommend the experience for an alternative way to spend an evening in Rome. Thanks Emanuele!

My brother and sister and I had a great time learning how to make pasta with Emanuele! He is a great teacher and obviously loves what he does..... I highly recommend this experience to everyone that loves to eat Pasta, It was DELICIOUS!! Once we got home we cooked for our family and they loved it!!

An amazing experience!
I’m glad we signed up for it....
Emanuele was very funny, explained everything very well step by step....
An awesome experience overall!!!!!!
Thank you Emanuele & Francesca!!!
This was my favorite part of our trip my sisters-in-law has a blast and as did my mother-in-law would recommend to everyone I know!!!

A must do! The pasta was delicious and you get to make it yourself! You will go home with pasta making skills to wow your friends. His experience is exceptional and I don't think you can get this experience anywhere else!
This experience was great! I would recommend this class to anyone traveling to Rome. Emanuele was very passionate and knowledgeable about his pasta making craft.

So much fun! I was visiting Rome by myself and wanted some fun evening activity, this pasta making class certainly fit the bill. Learned how to make delicious regular and vegan pasta! Emanuele's assistant Francesca was great and we were able to talk about what it's like to live Rome and be Italian in the context of the world. I loved both their perspectives. Would highly recommend for anyone else who likes to learn.

Fun experience in making true Italian pizza. As you walk up the road, you will see it on your left, as few people missed the place. Small shop but was a small group so Emanuele was able to focus and help out everyone and each had our own space to make. The environment was relaxing with music quietly playing in the background, and Emanuele was very dynamic, giving us tips, telling us stories and having fun in general. Great way to learn how to make different pasta and understanding the difference between homemade and supermarket bought. Afterwards, they cooked our pasta in two different sauces and we all sat down enjoying our pasta. Emanuele was great, gave us restaurant recommendations and his recipe to take home.
I loved everything about this class! He was so amazing. He was FUN & the class was very interesting. Learned a lot about making pasta!

Emanuele was the most passionate and enthusiastic host i have ever meet. Right from we stepped in is amazing pasta place we could feel is love for pasta. We where blown away by his story and knowledge and his teachingskills was point on! We made 4 different kind of pasta, with and without filling that we also made ourselves. Emanuele went above and beyond to insure that everyone and a great evening and made sure that everybody’s need was heard (language translation, allergens etc.)

The end result was shared buy everybody, at a big and beautiful table. The pasta was prepared by a chef who put the finishing touches on the dish, and served it. Emanuele served some of his best wine that evening and we sure need to get some to bring home.

Thank you for the best evening Emanuele!

What a wonderful experience! Emmanuele was very welcoming and so knowledgable. He managed to create a lovely group dynamic sharing the technical past making process in a very nice atmosphere. Emanuele’s pasta class— if there’s one thing you do during your time in Rome, take this class! It was fascinating to learn all about how pasta is made and he is so helpful throughout the process. I would high recommend this pasta course, it’s such an amazing experience.

If you have the opportunity to learn the art of making pasta from Emanuele you'd be lucky! Such a fun, intimate setting with a very personable chef. Nothing better than learning the Italian ways and eating your work. Don't miss this!

Grazie!

Great experience, you really get to learn to make the best pasta. Emanuele and his colleagues took care of themselves.

This was one of the best experiences I’ve ever had!! Once in a lifetime! It was so fun, educational and made a bunch of friends in the cooking class. Amazing and gourmet experience. We loved it. I would highly recommend it. Emmanuel's workshop is very beautiful and pleasant. Now we know how to make pasta ourselves!!

My wife and I had a fantastic night learning how to make pasta the traditional way. If there is one thing you do on your visit to Rome, do this. Emanuele was amazing. The class was so fun and he really paid attention to all of us individually as we tried to make pasta. Emmanuel is passionate about pasta and very friendly, he knew how to transmit his savoir faire to us all and built a great group dynamic.... A fantastic experience surpassing my expectations for my wife's suprise birthday present. Thank you Emmanuel!

Emanuele was great! He helped create a unique experience with a great group dynamic. He genuinely cared about the pasta making process and ensured everyone had a great time during the class. Totally would recommend!

It has always been on my bucket list to do a pasta making class in Rome. This class exceeded all of my expectations and was easily one of the top experiences in my life. We had such a fun time learning to make pasta in a professional kitchen. Emanuele was, very knowledgeable, a good teacher and very gracious. His recipes were delicious! He created a very relaxing atmosphere. I would recommend this experience to everyone I know!

Our family of five (including three teenagers) loved the pasta class. We learned so much and had lots of fun. We looked at a lot of different cooking classes and are so happy we chose this one. Our expectations were exceeded.

Emanuele’s pasta making class was something I will truly never forget! He was knowledgeable and passionate about the art of pasta making. He carried great conversation with the guests and was easy to get along with. He was kind, funny, and we all had an amazing time.

Would absolutely recommend.
Learning to make pasta with Emanuele was an incredible experience. We had so much fun and I look forward to taking what we learned with him and using it in the future!
An absolute wonderful cooking experience. Everything tasted splendid. It was extremely easy to follow along, and the group dynamic was amazing. Highly recommend!

This was such a fun and wonderful experience. Emanuele was attentive and helpful and passed on his passion for pasta (which was delicious). A highlight of my time in Roma. A wonderful combination of food and fun! I’m tempted to come back..

This was a great experience! I would definitely recommend this hands on class and feel that I learned something about making fresh ravioli that I can take back with me to the states and continue making at home. Also a good way to break up all the touristy activities in Rome.
Highly recommended! Emanuele was a great host and was clearly very passionate about pasta. Great way to learn about pasta and take a break from the touristy spots of Rome
It was a wonderful experience - a highlight of our trip. We learned many things about pasta and how to make it. We plan on making it again at home once we get back! Highly recommend!

We did this experience as a couple and really enjoyed it. Our goal was to feel like we could make pasta at home and this was achieved! A piece of Italian culture will go home with me after this evening but also a great memory. Thank you Emanuele and my fellow travelers for such a great time! Don’t think twice, just have to try this. Emmanuel provided a great experience throughout the cooking class. He shared his knowledge and made the pasta making process enjoyable. The meal at the end was wonderful.

It was so much fun ! Why not taking a cooking class when you are traveling.

Such an amazing class!! I would recommend to anyone for a fun afternoon and amazing meal! Emanuele was so passionate about cooking and we all loved the class!
Emanuele and his team were so warm and friendly-- this was the most fun we had in Rome-- !! The food was so delicious too! Thank you so much!
Amazing experience! My friends and I had a great time learning how to make pasta with Emanuele and we will definitely bring this knowledge back home with us!
Great experience making pasta in Italy. Emanuele is very passionate about pasta and it shows when he is working with you to instruct you on your pasta making skills.

My sister and I attended a cooking class with Emanuele and had the most incredible evening. Emanuele was fantastic, so friendly, knowledgeable and enthusiastic! Wonderful, fun & educational experience with Emanuele. Great to see someone so passionate and good at what they do, willing to share their knowledge. I’m going to enjoy putting what we learnt into practice. Fantastic and friendly host and lovely meal shared. Highly recommended!
This was by far one of the top highlights of our trip! Emanuele was awesome teacher and the pasta we made was delicious! We also made all pasta by hand without using a machine!

It was an unique experience. Emanuele was and generous to share all his knowledge with group. I was with may son, who felt a little sick and Emanuele was very kind and helpful and prepared a special pasta for him. I'll use forever all the things I learned in the class.

What a fantastic experience. what an incredible experience! receiving first class knowledge about pasta by someone who truly is an expert. Emanuele is warm, passionate, caring and so knowledgeable. This is a fantastic experience in Rome, the best cooking class I've ever had. During the class, you will enjoy the cooking process, as well as the result that you made, with the best pasta chef-

Amazing experience!! Emanuele’s passion and love for pasta making was contagious and made us feel like pros. Great pasta making class! My husband and I had tons of fun learning to make different types of pasta from scratch. Emanuele is a great teacher. You won’t regret it..

Emmanuel is a wonderful
Teacher who loves to make beautiful pasta. He has great attention to detail and a charming way to teach about his love of Italy and pasta. It’s fun and delicious.

Love Emmanuel personality! He’s such a sweet heart with passion for pasta! Thanks for the personal touch of signing my Chef hat !! Once in a lifetime experience

Emanuele’s smile and greeting was so warm and welcoming. Emanuele is knowledgeable and great at teaching. Emanuele creates a intimate but group dynamic setting cooking experience. Amazing! Emanuele took the time to explain every step and guided us through the pasta making process while making it fun! Loved sitting at the candle lit table with the whole group after to enjoy our dinner we had just made.

Awesome cooking class! Emanuele is a really good teacher passionate about sharing his talents. You leave this class with unique memories and you will know how to make high quality homemade pasta. Great evening! Learned a lot and had fun! And the meal was absolutely fresh and simple and delicious! I feel like I could definitely go home and make delicious pasta myself now - I'm excited to teach my friends and fam back home.

Great experience !!!!

Our family of four singned up for the class with Emanuele. It was a great experience to be able to make pasta with all variations and sauce could taste this good and that too so easy. We had an excellent experience and highly recommend to try this place if you really want to learn pasta making.
A fantastic pasta making class. Emmanualle was a very attentive teacher and an excellent host. This was the highlight of our trip to Rome. Highly recommend!

Unforgettable experience. Emanuele was very attentive and friendly. Instructions were easy to follow and Emanuele was very helpful throughout the process. The space was beautiful and the pasta was easily one of the best dishes I had while in Italy. Highly recommend!

Emanuele leads a very fun class and was accommodating to my vegan lifestyle. We had a great time making pasta, ravioli, and sauce. If you are looking for a true Rome experience, this is the one!

Our pasta making class with Emanuele was brilliant! A very good teacher and we learnt a lot, even the very technical elements - you really are making pasta from scratch! Thanks for a great evening, I’ll be making all my pasta in future 😊

Emanuele is extremely knowledgable and friendly which made this experience so enjoyable. I didn’t realise making pasta was so simple! Thank you Emanuele for teaching us something new and providing the highlight of our holiday!

A delightful evening! My 22-year old son and I joined a local food blogger and her daughter for this fun and easy intro to pasta-making. My boyfriend and I booked this class for our last day in Rome, and it made for a very memorable stay in Italy. The dishes were exceptional and we’ve been craving them since we left! Since then, we’ve made fettuccini with white ragu sauce, and ravioli, and we’re pleasantly surprised at how much we’ve learned and remembered! Our dishes taste exactly like they did that day. Thank you so much Emanuele, from Jacklyn and Jerry! We can’t wait to come back again!
Very nice experience, we had a great time. We recommend it is, we can't wait to try the recipes at home!!!
10/10! The space is so charming and the experience was amazing! Definitely a highlight of our trip to Rome. A must do! Thank you, Emanuele!

It was hulariously good, we have made the best possible pasta that can be only bought in special high-quality restorant, made with professional flavor, the quality of the lesson is more than we thought. I absolutely enjoyed this experience and would highly recommend it to anyone looking to do something unique during their trip to Rome. Emmanuel is a master in the dying art of handmade pasta. He will walk you through the process of preparing the dough, not only explaining the ingredients and what they do, but give a hands on experience in feeling , testing, then hand rolling the perfect pasta, in a way that a recipe can not communicate. Learn about combining the perfect elements cooked at precise times to make a surprising and life changing pasta sauce. We made the dough from fine flour and eggs, then spent time hand forming ravioli with our own mix of ingredients, with Emmanuel guiding and teaching about the nuances and techniques to use with the dough to create a gourmet quality plate. This experience was all I hoped and dreamed of when traveling to Italy, and I recommend it to all!

We had a lovely time with Emanuele and the other guests. We learned to make pasta and dumplings that we then tasted over a Montepulciano red wine from Abruzzo. It was very nice, Emanuele is very friendly and warm.

class for making famous Italian pasta...
Emanuel is a very nice, smiling pasta master who makes you an Italian Mama who can feed all his clan.
Recommended.

It was amazing! We made our own folder with the guidelines given by Emanuele. He was super nice and kind and attentive. This was an amazing experience. Emanuele is such a great teacher and made the process easy and I have since been able to duplicate at home what he taught me. My favorite part of my Rome vacation was making, cooking and eating homemade pasta with him. Thank you so very much for what you do.

this was great... very unique and personal as it was just myself and my husband in our group. we loved making the pasta and the additional elements of information about traditions and family as well. the pasta was delicous and he made the process easy to follow so you could go home and make it as well!

I highly recommend this great and delicious experience! Emanuele was very nice and an excellent teacher. Even my son enjoyed it and learned so much, he can't stop making pasta for the family every week since then. :)

Great time with Emanuele, he taught us all the techniques to make the best pasta!

I highly recommend this to anyone who has the time and opportunity. Emanuele is a really good teacher - pedagogical with a great passion for his work. Not the ordinary "touristy" stuff that i you usually do in Rome, so a fairly unique experience!

A great evening and a great experience with Emanuele! We enjoyed making our own pasta on our individual station and then had the opportunity to taste what we made. A nice atmosphere and a valuable experience. Definitely recommended especially because the group was small.

Chef Emanuele was a delightful host and instructor. He presented as a inclusive demonstration, explaining steps and inviting all in the class to smell, taste and touch and guiding us thru same process at our own stations immediately following, providing individual pointers and feedback.

Emanuelle was such a wonderful host and teacher! His instructions are clear and thorough, and paced in a way that each step easily builds on the last one. You start with a bowl of flour and a couple eggs and next thing you know you're making ravioli. The best part, of course, is when you get to sit down and enjoy the fruits of your labor!
We had a great time learning interesting cooking techniques. The food was delicious and very high quality. Emanuele was very nice and an excellent teacher. We highly recommend his class!

This was an amazing class! Very intimate, with hands on instruction by our instructor, and we learned how to make pasta from scratch without a machine. It’s not very touristy, and we made good friends at dinner afterwards. Highly recommend!

Perfect experience! Emanuele quickly puts you at ease. He explains very well, we try everything, and we do wonders! The meal ends the evening.

Thank you very much for this moment Emanuele, it will remain one of my very nice memories of Rome.

LEARN HOW TO MAKE PASTA FROM EMANUELE!

My pasta-loving husband and I took this class, and he has been making pasta at home since we came back, which is because this experience inspired us to see how easy it is to make pasta, and also how different fresh pasta is from the dry ones in a box. We loved it and are glad that we signed up for this class. Highly recommend this experience if you are coming to Rome, especially if you like pasta.
We had a great evening and are excited to make our own pasta. We can only recommend this experience.
Emanuele Is an expert in the field of pasta making and he has the skills and the personality to make the lesson easy to absorb so anyone can do it. A very enjoyable evening.

Emanuele held the perfect cooking class. He is extremely personable and explained everything clearly to us. We made three types of homemade pasta, two sauces, and had a wonderful feast and conversation at the end. Bravo Emanuele! We couldn’t have asked for a better experience.

We absolutely loved our experience making pasta with Emanuele. He’s knowledgeable and accomplished, yet warm and humble. He not only teaches you the recipe and techniques but also stresses the importance of intuition. We finished our night with great conversation over delicious pasta and a lovely bottle of wine. This was definitely the highlight of our stay in Roma.

Really enjoyed the pasta making experience with Emanuele. He was very funny and knowledgeable about pasta, and everything was prepared well enough beforehand where we weren't stuck with measuring or cleaning. We were able to learn and experience making 4 different types of pasta. Afterwards we chatted about Rome and pasta while eating and drinking wine. It was a lot of fun! My fiancé and I had a private session with Emanuele and we couldn’t be happier with how it turned out. He was such a gracious and prepared host! We learned SO much about making three different types of pasta and will be taking our lessons home with us to California. I highly recommend this special experience to anyone looking to do a pasta making class in Italy. Thank you Emanuele for being amazing!
We had a great time, our love of pastas has only grown thanks to Emanuele who is passionate about what he does! He gives us a real expertise! I recommend this experience:-)

Emanuele is personable and knowledgeable. We made ravioli with a spinach-ricotta filling (you make your own too), as well as one with a mushroom filling. He also taught us to colour the pasta dough. His kitchen had an interesting moody yellow-blue lighting, and soft jazz played in the background as everyone worked on their pasta. At the end of the night, he serves up your handiwork with a simple tomato sauce/ ragu. A delicious evening overall!
Great experience! We learnt how to make different types of pasta, fillings and sauces and we can do them all at home. Definitely trying it when we get back, thanks Emanuele

This is a class for serious pasta lovers. In the couple of hours with Emanuele, we learnt the techniques of making pasta and achieving the traditional pasta texture that can only be found in fresh handmade pasta. It is obvious that this class is specially curated to maximise the variety of pastas that you can do on your own at home. Emanuele encourage us to experiment with different fillings, show us the difference between egg and eggless dough, how to make the shape of the various different stuffed pasta and demostrated how sauces can compliment each pasta (love the simple sauce even though I usually don't prefer tomato based sauce), The combination of these will surely go a long way in making all sorts of pasta!

Last but not least, wonderful company with Emanuele and a lovely family whom we bond by eating each other pasta. Emanuele also recommend us the perfect place for the after dinner drink. Practically next door to his pastifico, ask him for the way!

Emanuele’s Professional Pasta Lab Experience was exceptional! We learned how to make ravioli, fettuccini (with and without eggs), and a simple sauce. My family and I would highly recommend this experience to anyone living in or visiting Rome!

an exceptional evening!!
Emanuele received us with generosity and kindness to share his passion for culinary art and especially the making of pasta , all with great simplicity and kindness. He opened his workshop for us or we were able to prepare our dumplings and tagliatelle which we then enjoyed together at a beautiful table set specifically for us, all in a friendly, warm and family atmosphere... we felt like exceptional guests.

Overall, this class is worth every penny. Would absolutely recommend to anyone wanting a little break from Rome’s hustle and bustle.

This pasta lab experience with Emanuele was a definite highlight of our family's 2 week trip to Italy and most highly recommended. We are a family of five - our three children daughters aged 20 & 26 and a son age 23, all love to cook and in planning the trip everyone wanted to include a cooking experience - am so glad we chose this one. We arrived to find a table beautifully set up for a nice dinner. Emanuele and his assistant Carmen greeted us, offered us some cold water, showed us where to wash our hands, gave us each a nice apron to put on - and then the fun began! The kitchen was set up for Emanuele to demonstrate the pasta we would be making. There were complete work stations (tools, ingredients, pasta board) for each of us to make our own pasta following the demonstration while Emanuele circulated to help us, providing great tips, how we could correct some of our mistakes - was very interesting and a lot of fun. We made 2 pasta recipes - one with Flour, water and eggs and one without the egg and cut into spaghtetti (using an interesting tool) and linguine size pasta. We made a ricotta/spinach filling for ravioli and actually made the ravioli, and also lasagna - 2 different shapes. All along the way Emanuele shared ways and ideas on how we could change the recipes.. He quickly cooked up the pasta in several courses (takes minutes to cook the fresh pasta!) and we enjoyed the pasta with a simple marina sauce, a ragu (with meat) sauce, a carbonara sauce and then we shared the lasagna - Emanuele sat down and ate with us, delicious wine was included, great conversation...We thoroughly enjoyed this evening. Emanuele showed us how he made the sauces and basically demystified it all, showing how the great sauces were easily and quickly made. We left stuffed and with a gift of some fresh pasta (which we cooked up 2 nights later in Siena), Emanuele also emailed us the recipes so we can replicate the sauces at home - we plan to make homemade pasta and sauces for our Christmas dinner, but hope to make some fresh pasta several times before then!! We had a great time at the Pastificio Faini Real Laboratory Pasta Experience, highly recommend the experience, Emanuele is extremely knowledgeable, personable and appears passionate about what he does! Ciao!
